182000.description:
Ujin Kang is an ordinary nobody—until one day, he gains a strange ability. Whenever he reads a script or screenplay, he’s pulled into a mysterious dimension where he can relive the character’s experiences. When he ends up showcasing a performance born from that dimension, his acting is so overwhelming that it leads to a massive misunderstanding. Mistaken for a once-in-a-generation acting prodigy, Ujin is suddenly thrust into a world of media and celebrities far beyond his quiet, insignificant life.

182001.description:
“Fate, save my unborn child…!” These are the last words of Princess Hinael as she plummets to her death at the hands of Count Chetaire, her unfaithful husband. Little does Hinael know that destiny will grant her a second chance, as she awakens two years in the past, shortly before her marriage. With her knowledge of what’s to come, Hinael attempts to rewrite the stars for herself and her future child. And what better way to achieve her ambitions than to court her kingdom’s former enemy, the dark and stern Prince Lutz of the Empire of Triekas?

(Source: WEBTOON)

He’s ready to disprove her misconceptions and eager to jump into marriage to make both of their mothers happy. He likes her; she needs him. That’s enough, right? Will she find happiness, or is she doomed to live out this charade to please others?

(source: Tapas)

182003.description:
Ever since the discovery that she was not the emperor's real daughter, Daphne has lived a lonely life as a maid at the imperial palace. Amidst the daily bullying and mockery she suffers from others, her sole solace is Asherad, the Crown Prince. He is the only one who treats her with warmth, and she can't help but fall for his kindness. However, Asherad's kindness is merely a cloak for his cruelty and possessiveness. When Daphne discovers his true nature, she resolves to leave his side… But will she be able to outrun Asherad's obsession with her?

If Eloise can mold Ian into the ideal husband for her beloved Diana, she can give her the perfect ending. Unfortunately, she finds that it may be harder than she thinks...

In the imperial capital, Elayl, hardened detective Rogue has to make a deal with the most despicable criminal of them all—because only Miseria, the witch who unleashed hell on the world, has the kind of power that can help him solve the case surrounding the Lifetaker. Consumed by jealousy, Jeremy openly displays affection for Lucian in front of Daniel, trying to drive a wedge between them. One who can have everything except the one he wants. Up-and-coming actor Seo Gang-U is up for "Rookie of the Year" when his former lover, industry exec Lee Ji-Won, suggests they act like a couple in public. With his lingering affection for Ji-Won, Gang-U jumps at this chance to be close to her again. Although it's all supposed to be acting, will Gang-U's real feelings for Ji-Won blow everything?

But Yoonwoo's incarceration takes a surprising turn when none other than the man who put him up to this whole thing shows up in handcuffs. Just how will Yoonwoo make it through his sentence with such an unlikely cast of inmates, no alpha by his side, and a baby on the way?

One day, a fallen angel named Kwak Rowan comes to him as a client. And much to Yise's surprise, Rowan asks him to find the whereabouts of Kang Yise so he can eliminate the latter! Despite not being able to die, Yise is still baffled by Rowan's desire to kill him. Can he hide his identity long enough to find out why?

Her exceptional tea-making skills quickly catch the court's attention. Navigating the tricky politics of tea time, Erica must charm the demanding Crown Prince with her unique blends. Each cup she crafts could bring her closer to her dream of opening a teahouse in the capital or spell disaster. Join Erica in a delightful mix of comedy, romance, and royal intrigue, where every brew has the power to shape her destiny and uncover secrets.

Armed with nothing but her real-world hotelier skills and a diary from the real Rose full of cryptic hints but no escape route, she's forced to navigate a dangerous world teeming with Kalix's enemies. Can she keep his wrath in check, evade death, and find her way back to reality before it's too late?

So when the adorable Luna and Luca show up at the door of her gingerbread house, Hazel is determined to care for the siblings. However, things go awry when their guardian and brother, Grand Duke Elliot Blaine, show up, accusing her of kidnapping them. Now, with her charm and cooking skills, Hazel must prove she is indeed a sweet witch!

182042.description:

In the case of Marso, she tried hard to change the storyline by performing good deeds and taking care of the female lead. However, things are not going as she had hoped for—every character in the story still hates her! It seems no matter what she does she cannot seem to change her fate. Tired of trying, Marso declares that she'll stay home and do nothing—for the rest of her life.

In her second life, she takes revenge by taking her own life in front of him. But despite her desperate wish for an end, she’s given another chance at life. However, this time, instead of encountering Hyo-Jo, she is discovered by Hwi-Ta, a mysterious man with a black wolf as his guardian spirit. Can Yeon-U break the cycle and find true safety in this treacherous underworld?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

(Source: Arechi Manga)

182046.description:
An immortal high school student, So-Yeong is secretly crushing on human golden retriever Hui-Jae. Mysteriously, he keeps coming into near-death danger and So-Yeong repeatedly sacrifices herself to protect him. Something begins to grow between the two, and someone doesn't like that. What will happen to their lives and fate?!

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

182047.description:
On the day of my wedding, I found out that my lover was cheating on me with my best friend. I died because of their betrayal, and when I opened my eyes again, I returned to the past. I thought this was a blessing from God, a chance to take revenge. But this return was neverending as I kept dying either from their betrayal or in an accident. After my repeated death, I realized that accidents did not cause all of my deaths but that I was being murdered. So this time, I faked my death and left everything behind to catch the murderer, who was killing me repeatedly and to take my revenge finally.

(Source: WEBTOON)

182048.description:
Timid orphan Violet discovers she's the empire's new saint destined to destroy the evil Malum. Unfortunately, she's surrounded by scornful nobles and the power-hungry emperor and pope. Alone, friendless, and overwhelmed, she finds solace in Ethelmund, heir of House Ermengart, who vows to protect her until the end. Can this fragile wildflower find her footing in the thorny and dangerous world of politics and betrayal? And will she be able to fulfill her destiny with only Ethelmund by her side?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Violets Blooming in the Back Garden

Hyeon-U makes a living busking in subway stations. Turns out being blind makes people a lot more generous — and a lot more confiding. But when a strange man approaches him with a secret of his own, Hyeon-U is suddenly entangled in a murder case, turning his life upside down.

Sophia Riller, sixteen years old, was about to attend the Blessing Ceremony--a ritual in which a boy or girl of sixteen years is gifted with abilities from one of the various animal gods. A blessing from one of the bird gods could grant wings that allow one to soar through the skies. The boons are many and varied. Sophia, a clumsy type, was hoping that she would be chosen by a god that doesn't stand out...but...it was the Gorilla God who chose her! She was told that those blessed by the Gorilla God will have a gift for combat and needs to take the exam to become a Junior Knight. On the exam day, she met Louis, a handsome knight-to-be and two boys, who soon found out who Sophia was blessed by. Her life changes completely from that day...

Determined not to frighten them, Suu embraces a herbivorous lifestyle. 182136.description:
Xia Yang is a college student that's a sucker for people with good looking faces and has been a fan of the idol, Jiang Zhengze, for many years. He is obsessed with idols, crazy about idols, and would do anything for his idols. But one day, the idol he longed for turned into a demon who wants to eat him up, constantly pushing him to the edge of his sanity. Thus his agonizing and turbulent cohabitation life begins...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

182138.description: Ryouichi Aruji has a live-in maid named Maguro-san working at his home. Maguro-san may be absolutely flawless when it comes to her duties as a maid, but her sense of personal boundaries seems to be completely broken, and she has no problem firing off one dirty joke after another!

182139.description:
Seonghyeon Han is a victim of a violent crime that left him with impaired legs and a fear of the outside world. Now, he faces an even greater challenge: while he gained the power to create clones, he has just 24 hours before being sent to another dimension. As the countdown ticks down, Seonghyeon makes a desperate move -- he sends his clone through the interdimensional portal, and discovers his real body can remain safe at home. Thus begins the epic tale of Seonghyeon's... clones.

(Source: WEBTOON)

My Alter Ego's Path to Greatness

182160.description:
Amidst a zombie apocalypse, Vin Yeom, an exterminator, finds a new purpose as an undertaker, specializing in funerals for the infected. Within the walls of the quarantine zone, he and his team navigate a treacherous world, providing solace to grieving families. Their company offers a unique but costly service that bridges the gap between life and death, allowing for one last goodbye. But in this world of death and despair, secrets linger, and the very loss that led Vin down this path may unearth a conspiracy that will shock the world and perhaps... help him find his way back.

(Source: WEBTOON)

182164.description:
Marin, a caretaker from the Dream Management Bureau, works with Bakuo, a Dream Tapir, to turn young girls' nightmares into sweet dreams. Perhaps they'll come to visit you at your pillow tonight...? A heartwarming dreamy fantasy!

(source: Kodansha, translated)

182166.description:
You ask anxiously, "Is it okay if I’m the one?"

It’s precisely because of that side of you that I want to stay by your side.

Fukusuke, a nice but plain guy, falls in love at first sight with the most beautiful girl in class, Yua. However, the one rumored to be with Yua is Fukusuke's best friend, the basketball ace, Yuusei. He sighs at the thought of an unrequited love.

One day, Fukusuke discovers another super cute girl hiding in Yua's shadow, Usuba Amari, who doesn’t stand out.

“Um, w-would you be my friend?”

He starts practicing to “become normal” with the shy girl, but—

“Amari-chan, the one you admire is Yuusei, right?”

“...”

“W-Why is your face so red?”

A love comedy unfolds as Fukusuke begins a friendship with the hidden beauty that only he knows.
synonyms: I Found Amari-chan Next to the Number One Girl I Wanted to Make My Girlfriend

182177.description:
Song Joo-hee, who is unable to live her own life because she is busy paying off her family's debt, coincidentally meets Kang Se-ra, a rich girl who ran away from home, and they spend a night together. She is so charmed by her that she accepts her offer to live together...

(Source: Naver, translated)

182178.description:
A mystery hangs over the remote island of Manwol. The locals have all perished after being turned into monsters in an experiment by the imperial army. But Geumran, a young deaf girl, inexplicably survives, recovering her hearing and gaining incredible strength. Though she kills all of the soldiers in cold blood, Geumran soon learns that the same fate that befell the villagers awaits her too. Finding those responsible for the experiments thus becomes her only hope for survival... and vengeance.

(Source: Tapas)

Notes:
- A spin-off webtoon of the Netflix original series “Gyeongseong Creature”. The worldview is the same, but the story and background are different.
- Chapter count includes Chapter 0.
synonyms: Gyeongseong Creature Side Story: A Flower That Never Fades

182179.description:
Under the rule of the Solitary King Wilfred, who purged his own brother to enforce his reforms, Princess Alicia from a neighboring country was wed to him in a political marriage.

"Your Majesty, you're actually quite a kind person, aren't you?"

"...What?"

While everyone feared and revered him, Alicia, who was raised as a commoner for certain reasons, closed the distance with her natural cheerfulness and friendliness. As she rejoiced, laughed, and even got angry for his sake, Wilfred gradually opened his heart to her—

And now, the life of the happiest couple is about to begin!
synonyms: Until the Solitary King and the Sunshine Bride Become the Happiest Couple
The Lonely King and His Sunshine Bride’s Happily Ever After

182183.description:
Hiyakawa-san’s handsome but perpetually frowning face strikes fear into the hearts of his co-workers. But around Tetsuhara Miori, his façade slips—often getting clumsy, careless, and blurting out his true thoughts. Now she’s dealing with a mumbling, bumbling, blushing boss! Awkward and sweet days unfold when you have a boss this flustered in this workplace romantic comedy!

(Source: Manga UP!)

Notes:
- All chapters were split into multiple parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume releases.
- Includes one extra chapter.

182184.description:
Ahjin is a crippled boy doing house chores under insomniac gang boss Seokju. Unexpectedly, they make two damaged sides of a good pair. Unfortunately, fate has other ideas for them, and as their lives spiral downwards, one question remains: are they damned to this destiny, or can they find a happy ending?

(Source: Lezhin US)

182185.description:
Seong-Ha seeks a big man to fulfill his desires. At a freshman retreat, he meets Mu-Beom — a big guy with glasses that make his eyes tiny. Impervious to seduction and a total square, Mu-Beom puzzles Seong-Ha. Seong-Ha hates alphas, and Mu-Beom has a thing for pheromones. How will this odd pair turn out?

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

182187.description:
People in this world are born with “skills” and “jobs." Our main character, Heat, has the unique skill of “invulnerability,” but his job was “the weakest commoner,” which does not grow in strength even with experience. Born with such a seemingly useless job, he is about to be fired from his adventuring party. However, Nuun, the A-ranked wizard was suppose to replace him, objects to this change…?

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

Koichi Fujikawa's younger sister is absolutely obsessed with Ryu, the center of the popular idol group CRown Sugar. One day, his class is abuzz with rumors of a new transfer student—who turned out to be Tatsuki Amada, AKA Ryu, his sister's favorite idol! While Koichi is excited to meet Ryu in the flesh, it seems like the guy is a bit...dangerous?

182195.description:
Umesawa, an office worker, has an archenemy. His name is Haze, a stubborn and demanding guy who he used to work with. Haze suddenly quit without saying a word to him, and ever since, Umesawa has been hung up on him. So much so that every time he remembers Haze, he gets super irritated. One day, they reunite at a bar that Umesawa happens to enter. Haze treats Umesawa coldly and tells him to leave since the place is a gay bar. What are Haze's intentions...? A love story between two bickering ex-colleagues begins!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

182197.description:
Kashiwagi, in his 30s, has just moved into a new industry. His brilliant younger boss and mentor, Amamiya, seems a bit uncomfortable interacting with him, an older subordinate. Concerned about their relationship, Kashiwagi waits for an opportunity to have a relaxed conversation with him, but catching up with the very busy Amamiya proves difficult. One day after work, Kashiwagi runs into Amamiya who is working overtime. He offers to help, hoping to improve their relationship even if just a little, but...? What surprising suggestion comes from Amamiya, the capable younger boss...!?

182202.description:
My horny girlfriend and I went on a period of abstinence from sex for three months.

In order to get my girlfriend who's got a strong libido to settle down, we agreed on a period of abstinence from sex for three months; but on the contrary, doing this only made our sexual desires stronger: turning into a story about how we found ourselves having wild sex that's hotter than anything we've ever had before.

Contains a depiction of multiple orgasms.

(Source: Melonbooks, translated)

182203.description:
Inase, a college student in the Film Club, hates romance to the point of saying “I don't need love in my life." But then he has a life-changing encounter…

(Source: Young Animal, translated)

182208.description:
Bun is an elementary school student spends his life cheerfully at a rural school with his classmates, who are like brothers to him. He gets into trouble with the students of the main school who always bully him, and eventually things get very serious...!

A masterpiece created by Shinji Nagashima's love for children's manga!

(Source: Group Zero, translated)

182212.description:
"I really liked that voice—"

On the day of the school entrance ceremony, Teppei Kodaira got absolutely charmed by the voice of Tsugumi Kuritani, who delivered a speech as the representative of the incoming freshman students. By complete coincidence, Teppei's seat in class was also right next to the owner of "that voice", Kuritani-san. But just when he thinks they'll gradually become closer...

Kuritani-san sends him a message: "Teppei, it's embarrassing to let you hear my voice just for the sake of your reactions!" Kodaira-kun wants to hear her voice, and Kuritani-san doesn't want to be heard by him. A frustrating and "pure" romcom between these two begins!!

(Source: Comipo, translated)
synonyms: Kodaira-kun Wants to Hear Her Voice

title.native: 声が聞きたい小平くん

182213.description:
"Someday, I want to travel the world. Just the two of us."

Sophia, the fourth princess of the Kingdom of Finland, is my fiancée. I am Youta Kagami, a former magic researcher. For certain reasons, we had been living among adults and leading research-focused lives since childhood. But we had a dream: "To attend the magic academy and enjoy a normal youth."

At fifteen, I retired from research, and tomorrow was supposed to be the start of our cohabitation in the academy city. However, on the day of the entrance ceremony, I received word that she had died in a maritime accident.

After that... I don’t even remember how I confirmed her body.

The next thing I recall is being back in the new home where the two of us were supposed to live, and in my blurry vision, an apparition flickered.

Is this a dream...?

Before my eyes is the most precious smile in the world.

—Hey, Sophia. Aren't you dead?
synonyms: Sophia, Aren't You Dead? I Retired From Magic Research, and I Was Supposed to Enjoy Academy Life With the Nordic Princess’s Fiancé...

title.native: ソフィア、君は死んでいないのか？　～魔法研究を引退した俺は、北欧王女の婚約者と学園生活を楽しむ……はずだった～
title.romaji: Sophia, Kimi wa Shinde Inai no ka? Mahou Kenkyuu wo Intai Shita Ore wa, Hokuou Oujo no Konyakusha to Gakuen Seikatsu wo Tanoshimu... Hazu Datta

182214.description:
Aiden is a quarterback and Seo-Won is a chronically-ill forest boy. Could it be any more obvious? Seo-Won can’t quite bring himself to believe that a popular football player has been crushing on him for years, but Seo-Won’s remote forest home might be the perfect place for romance to take root. But Aiden is only visiting Korea–is two weeks enough time to establish a relationship, or…a family?

(Source: Tapas)

title.native: ウミガミ～絶島のジェノサイド～
瑠璃色ア・ラ・カルト
魔法少女プリティサミー
アキバ系ネットアイドルプロジェクト

182225.description:
A quiet daily life is disrupted by a gal. Well, it’s a bit annoying... (but also a bit exciting)?

I, Toya Yukifumi, am the only member and president of the literary club at my high school. What do we do? For instance... we read the works of my beloved author, Miyazawa Kenji, and engage in lively activities... Just kidding, I really just stay in my room reading (crying).

One day, a gal named Shibusawa Mione transfers from Tokyo and joins our peaceful literary club.

(Why? How? She doesn’t seem like the type at all!)

From that day on, the literary club starts to change, getting swept up in her energy as we follow in Kenji’s footsteps, running around Iwate and searching for “true happiness.”

Wait a minute (happy)! Give me back my peaceful days (lie)!

Transfer student × Literature × Romantic feelings = The beginning of a new youth novel!

182226.description:
I'm going to marry everyone and start my harem life.

"Jin... our journey together ends here." Jin, who had formed a party with his childhood friend, the Hero Reki, and set out on an adventure to defeat the Demon Lord, was suddenly told goodbye just before their final battle. Devastated, Jin returned to his hometown. However, the party members quickly defeated the Demon Lord and began proposing to Jin one after another—!?

"Jin, do you remember the promise we made when we were kids?"

"You said you'd marry me, right?"

"Jin-san, what should we name our baby?"

Unknowingly, Jin had promised to marry three different people and was about to build a polygamous harem!

"E-everyone, calm down!"

Thus begins the harem x slow-life fantasy!
synonyms: After Being Kicked Out of the Hero's Party, I Returned to My Hometown, But All the Members Followed Me

title.native: 勇者パーティーをクビになったので故郷に帰ったら、メンバー全員がついてきたんだが

182228.description:
Seventeen year old Satsuki Moriyama is enjoying her life to the fullest with the boyfriend of her dreams! After 3 months of dating, they finally hold hands and Satsuki is over the moon! Sasaki-kun is the coolest and her reason for living, yet...

(Source: MANGA Plus)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: ルナティック・テラポップ

182230.description:
Sometimes this world feels as suffocating as drowning in water. Even when the lights are on, I feel like I'm in the dark. I want to be illuminated. I want to connect. To be honest, I hook up with people all the time, but no one ever really finds me. With a dating app, you might become connected to someone by a thread of fate. Even if it's not right. Even if it is a distorted desire. Even if there are people out there who get pleasure from hurting themselves and others. Happiness is the number of matches, and so is hell. You and I can sink and drown together. This story is about various people who match up on “dating apps."

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

182232.description:
“I’ll do my best with bridal training!” A cohabitation rom-com with a tsundere beauty.

“I’m done with you. I hate you! Don’t ever show your face to me again!”

“Alright. Let’s never see each other again.”

Kudo Souta and Amelia Lily Stafford grew close while attending school in England. But when Lily learned that Souta was returning to Japan, she got angry, and they parted ways after a fight.

Six months later, Lily transfers to Souta’s high school in Japan and, on top of that, chooses his house for her home-stay. As Souta is confused by their sudden reunion and cohabitation, he asks, “What are you doing in Japan?” With flushed cheeks, Lily answers, “Bridal training.”

Overwhelmed by a Tidal Wave of Dripping-Wet Sweat!

Full of pride and overconfidence, these players think they got a timid airhead on their hands, but the script gets flipped behind closed doors. Bravado escapes when pinned down by a grade-A amazon who knows how to pamper and spoil their newfound toy. Exploring every inch, they detect every tic that makes their new toy flinch, melting them into a puddle.The love juice is worth the squeeze, and they'll milk out every ounce they can muster because nothing can stop these insatiable knockouts from getting what they want.

Overflow! by Tamabon is overflowing with brain-melting pleasure featuring dizzy girls with a few screws loose! For all sorts of squirt perverts and femdom lovers, Overflow is for everyone who loves the shame, pleasure, and vulnerability of being dominated, and seeing someone's body and soul turn into a hot mess! Collecting seven sensual chapters, TAMABON shows that all sorts of things come gushing forth when love and lust collide, and once they start, they don't stop!

182234.description:
“Why don’t we kiss… as a test?”

Second year high school student, Kazami Ibuki, has a cheeky childhood friend: the rumored most beautiful girl in the school with blonde hair and sapphire eyes, named Kamishiro Airi.

Airi claims she habors no romantic feelings whatsoever and would tease him at every opportunity.

“…I suggested we try kissing. If you don’t think of me as a woman… it shouldn’t phase you, right?”

Airi pointed at her lips, provokingly.

Ibuki decided that today for sure he’ll make her know her place.

“Well?, were you just acting tough?”

“N-No, of course that’s not it!”

Unable to pull away, the two vigorously kissed.

From that day onward, Airi started becoming more cutesy than expected…?

An impassioned sweet love comedy that started with a kiss with a cheeky beautiful girl!

Who for some reason can’t be honest with themselves even though their feelings are definitely mutual.

Within London dwells humanoid monsters that eat only men—Witches. In order to exterminate them, the British Secret Intelligence Service MI6 formed a unit known as RED.

Ruby Blood, a young genius Witch Hunter, is a member of this unit. Off duty, she's just an ordinary, fun-loving girl who loves food, her family, and most of all, her father’s home-cooked dinners.

But on Christmas Night, something happens that changes her fate entirely...

After alien lifeforms known as "Trenchwalkers" land in Antarctica, they transform the planet, causing sea levels to rise by 70 meters and submerging cities like Tokyo. Furthermore, they begin converting Earth’s water into a divine substance, "Nectar," which proves fatal to those whose bodies cannot adapt to it. A handful of girls who can withstand the Nectar are chosen to board a submarine, equip special swimsuits, and head to the battlefield to reclaim our planet. Upon receiving the dying message of her older sister, Todoroki Hiro goes in search for the strongest marine soldier Tsunoba Kiriri, and despite her heart being full of uncertainties, she chooses to enroll in the Masakado Girls' Academy Submarine Fleet. However, will it actually be smooth sailing for her?! Girls in swimsuits, water guns, and high-stakes combat: the ultimate splash-action battle for Earth is here!

Sakura is the second daughter of the Odoru family who has lived a quiet life between her talented older sister and her beautiful younger sister. She has no special skills except for taming small magical beasts. However, her life changes overnight when she is taken away to become the bride of Prince Kai, a man feared as the War God.

The reason for her sudden marriage is that Sakura possesses a body that can act as a scabbard for the legendary Demon-Slaying Sword. Although Kai keeps her by his side only for this purpose, her wisdom and kindness begin to change the cold prince little by little. This is a beautiful Cinderella romance about two people who struggle to express their feelings but eventually find a deep and lasting love.

182253.description:
The torso of a headless, limbless body is found half-buried by a riverbank. It belonged to middle-aged mother Yaeko Miyagawa, and after an investigation and trial, her daughter Hikari eventually confesses to her murder. For many years, Hikari had been subjected to physical and emotional abuse by her mother, revolving around her failure to make it into a top medical school and become a doctor. Even after nine years of futile applications and entrance exams, Yaeko refused to free her daughter from this virtual prison. What led to the fatal stabbing that ended Yaeko's life? This series, based on a true story, will explore Hikari Miyagawa's experiences up to her greatest tragedy—and what happened to her afterward.

In light of this, Archen is assigned to assist them on the mission.

As the team reaches the dungeon's depths, Riolu recalls Ampharos's advice, and the team is suddenly attacked by a territorial Garchomp, who approaches from above and declares them intruders.

182258.description:
It has been a century since anyone in the Siegfried clan was born with the Power of God. Desperate to keep their grip on the crown, the royal family resorts to sending its scions to a clandestine laboratory once they turn eight in hopes the brutal experiments conducted there will awaken the children to the family’s latent abilities. When it comes time for Sigurd, first in line for the throne, to undergo the procedures, there is but one thing on his mind: He must manifest the Power of God to spare his five-year-old sister Brunhild the same fate. Though Sigurd triumphantly returns three years later, bearing unprecedented command over the Power of God, the kind brother Brunhild knew is gone, replaced by a violent boy who has forgotten his own identity. Eventually, Sigurd grows tired of Brunhild and banishes her, only to call her back to the royal palace when she awakens to divine abilities of her own. Now betrothed to her brother, Brunhild must find a way to placate the unstable prince if she is to have any chance of surviving…

(Source: Yen Press)

182269.description:
At the end of World War II, a demon-summoning ritual drastically altered the face of the earth. Now, a hundred years later, demons rule the world, and humanity fights back using magicite-powered armored mechs. In the year 2055, a boy named Keita Kawakami enrolls in Japan's military academy. Possessing memories of an alternate modern era, he successfully pilots a prototype mech that no one else has even been able to activate. When Keita is suddenly deployed to the battlefield, he uses the knowledge from his previous life to achieve results that defy all established norms. Thus begins humanity's battle to reclaim the world.

Lim Hyeonseon has lived an ordinary life, and now, as he reaches his forties, he feels an urge to start something new before it’s too late. He decides to take guitar lessons and joins a music academy. There, he meets Cha Yeoreum, a young and passionate guitar instructor. As their friendship grows, Hyeonseon begins to rediscover a sense of vitality and excitement in his life. But life is never without its surprises. When Yeoreum starts to reveal his tender affection for Hyeonseon, their relationship takes an unexpected turn, bringing new challenges and emotions to the surface.

182273.description:
"I want to stay by your side forever."

A love-comedy about restarting youth, featuring a villain reincarnation protagonist and his favorite heroine!

After working too much at a black company, I lost consciousness, only to wake up reincarnated into the world of my favorite romcom story: as the doomed villain, Shindou Ryuusuke.

Filled with hope at the chance to relive my youth at the school I admired, I swear to reform myself using my knowledge of the original story. That's when I meet the beautiful girl Amanatsu Mashiro, who shares the same fate of a villain.

In order to save her from a disastrous future, I try to keep my distance, but—

"I want to stay by your side, Ryuusuke!"

Mashiro, who wished to never be separated from me no matter what happens. There’s only one wish I want to fulfill with such a perfect heroine. Even a villain wants to enjoy youth, right?

The popular romcom of villain reincarnation and restarting youth begins here!

182276.description:
"Hey, Wanna Do It?"

A love comedy about starting a cohabitation relationship that’s neither friends nor lovers, featuring a wounded queen!

One night, while working part-time at a convenience store, college student Yamamoto is approached by a female customer in sweatpants at the register. Her name is Hayashi Megumi, a former classmate from high school and the most beautiful girl in the class. Due to her strong-willed and arrogant nature, she was often called a "queen."

Despite their previously strained relationship, as Yamamoto engages in light conversation with her, he notices a painful bruise on her wrist. After hearing that it was caused by her boyfriend hitting her, he decides to take her back to his apartment to shelter her for the time being. However, just as he is about to go to sleep, she suddenly hugs him from behind…!?

What will happen to the relationship between the observant guy and the wounded queen as they begin their cohabitation from such a terrible start!?

182278.description:
"I know we both have feelings for each other, so please confess quickly, Senpai!"

Keigo, the strict and disliked student council president, and Chiharu, a junior council member who is the child of famous actors and is well-behaved and popular, are both unaware that the other has feelings for them, making it hard for them to get closer.

One day, they buy matching amulets at a matchmaking shrine, and that night, they meet in a dream. Since it’s just a dream, they reveal their true feelings and passionately confess to each other.

"Don't act flirtatiously with someone like me, who’s an outcast!" "But I like you! Everything I do is for the sake of being united with you, Senpai!"

However, is Keigo the only one who remembers the events of the dream—? In reality, she’s a cunning little devil, but in the dream, her feelings are fully exposed, leading to a reversal of roles?! A fresh and transparent love comedy begins here!

"My body is being targeted by an overly innocent foreign girl!?"

Choi Kyuhyuk is officially classified as an S-class Esper, but there’s a catch. His self-regeneration ability is so weak that he's been downgraded to S-minus. People call him a “half-baked” Esper, and the name has stuck ever since. After sustaining a serious injury, he has been reassigned to a desk job in the Guide Line Department, where he now trains rookie Guides. Life was relatively peaceful until one very specific problem arrived. Yeon Soo-Jung, a Guide Kyuhyuk once saved as a child and treats like family, has just come of age. And now, he wants to initiate a sex guiding session with Kyuhyuk. Worse still, Soojung makes his intent painfully clear:

“Just sleep with me once. Let me give you the sex guiding, please.”

Sure, guiding is essential for Espers to stabilize their powers. But the idea of doing it with him sends Kyuhyuk into full panic mode.

“Wait, Soo-Jung. I'm really not mentally prepared for this yet...”

“But sir, your erection says otherwise.”

Caught between professional ethics and personal chaos, Kyuhyuk now faces the most awkward guiding session of his life. And it’s with the one person he never expected.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes four side story chapters.

Lila lives her life with her partner, Lalamon, using a Digimon summoning app. One day, an announcement is made that the service will be shutting down...

(Source: Official Digimon site)

Note: Second Prize winner in the 2023 Digimon Comic Awards.
synonyms: Digimon Bloom: Will the Electronic Flower Fall?

title.native: デジモンブルーム-電子の花は散るか-
title.romaji: Digimon Bloom: Denshi no Hana wa Chiru ka

182415.description: Due to special circumstances, Tsuyoshi Toudo is a boy who has trouble understanding the feelings of other people. Betrayed by his friends, Tsuyoshi decides to protect himself with his special power. That power—’Reset’—allows him to erase all emotions towards those people. Hana Hanazono is a childhood friend who realizes she was "reset" by Tsuyoshi due to a lie she told to hide her embarrassment. She regrets her inability to be honest, and starts approaching Tsuyoshi to rebuild their relationship from scratch. It’s a story of an awkward boy aspiring to be "normal," regaining his youth by "starting over" with the girls who mistreated him.
synonyms: My Childhood Friend Called Me a Man of Convenience Behind Back, I Want to Reset My Favor and Live a Normal Youth.
Osananajimi ni Kage de Tsugou no Ii Otoko Yobawari Sareta Ore wa, Koui wo Reset Shite Futsuu ni Seishun wo Okuritai

title.native: 幼馴染に陰で都合の良い男呼ばわりされた俺は、好意をリセットして普通に青春を送りたい
title.romaji: Osananajimi ni Kage de Tsugou no Yoi Otoko Yobawari Sareta Ore wa, Koui wo Reset Shite Futsuu ni Seishun wo Okuritai

title.native: ホントは君としたいヒミツのこと!
title.romaji: Honto wa Kimi to Shitai Himitsu no Koto!

182418.description:
When she was still in junior high school, Nahana fell in love with Tanukida, a star player at the Koshien tournament called “the talent of the century." She enrolls in the same high school and becomes a student manager for the baseball team, hoping to get close and cheer on her senpai, and maybe even go out with him, too. However, Tanukida has a secret of his own!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 狸田先輩の青春になりたい

182421.description:
In his seventh life, drenched in blood, Ryu Hui-Kyeom seeks only one thing—revenge. After rescuing a shaman in distress, Ryu Hui-Kyeom is granted five lives, but each one ends in a tragic death. Now, as he is reborn once more, he is driven by the relentless desire to avenge the betrayal that haunts him. However, in this seventh life, something unexpected disrupts his plans, causing events to unfold differently from the way he remembers.

"Now that we're married, whether you live or die, you are mine."

By a twist of fate, Hui-Kyeom becomes the favored concubine of King Jin Hyeok-Wi, who shows an unsettling obsession with him.

"If you try to escape, I'll cut off your legs and keep you in the palace."

Caught between the possessive love of a king and his unyielding thirst for vengeance, Hui-Kyeom's quest for revenge in his seventh life takes an unforeseen turn.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes two side story chapters.

title.native: ねじれの位置は交差しない

182425.description: When Haruto submits his manga manuscript to a publisher he gets a shocking piece of advice: "If you want to be a manga artist, why don't you try making doujinshi?". Then his twin sister convinces him to join her in making... BL doujinshi!?

title.native: ドージン活動、はじめました!?

182426.description:
His beloved crush was snatched up by the nerdy new student. Furious, Ren Zhichu tries to harass that nerd at every chance he gets. Unexpectedly, during their interactions with each other, Ren Zhichu actually develops feelings for that nerd...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

182427.description:
"Would I not be good enough in place of my sister?"
“Hold on a second, that wedding’s not happening!”

On the day of the ceremony, Shin, the groom, is left standing alone as his bride is stolen right in front of a large crowd. The next morning, exhausted and drained, his fiancée’s younger sister, Nene, shows up at his door—and before he knows it, he finds himself being doted on and living a life of indulgent pampering under her care!?
synonyms: Having Had my Bride Stolen, I Just Want to Live Peacefully.

title.native: 花嫁を略奪された俺は、ただ平穏に暮らしたい。
title.romaji: Hanayome wo Ryakudatsu Sareta Ore wa, Tada Heion ni Kurashitai.

182428.description:
After transmigration, both the protagonist and his master's original personas have gone out the window!!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)
synonyms: Anecdotes with Master After the Novel Transmigration

title.romaji: Chuan Shuhou Yu Shi Zun Ersan Shi

182429.description:
After stealing a divine carrot from the Heavenly Emperor’s garden, rabbit spirit Ling Qi is punished with endless reincarnations across three thousand mini-worlds. His mission? To play the role of twisted cannon fodder, obsessive villain, or dark antagonist. And all for one mission, and one mission alone, to be the thorn in the relationship between the main protagonists. He swears never to resort to seduction— but often fails. After lifetimes of chaos and performances, one truth finally comes to light, was it all just part of the Heavenly Emperor’s grand plan from the start?

(Source: Webnovel)

182430.description: Sheng Nuan, a game developer who dies in an accident and has a chance to be resurrected if she completes enough missions. She has to travel to different worlds as a disposable secondary character who has to stop the villains from turning evil. However, she discovers that all these supposedly cold-blooded villains are getting all flirty and trying to seduce her in various ways. She will have to deal with the hilarious and dangerous situations that arise in each world, as well as her own feelings.

Quick Transmigration: The Villain Is Too Spoiled and Flirty

182431.description:
“I’m a worshipper of this city’s god!”
This story is about an unlucky and atypical youth who agitates a peaceful city by worshipping his divinity.
“Be it a ghost or demon, no one can stop me from adoring the Xuming god! Not even Xuming himself!”

(Source: Tencent, translated)

182433.description:
One day, a haughty god descended from the heavens and demanded a teenager serve him:
“Boy, if you do not wish to die, offer yourself to me!”
The boy eventually unbuttoned his shirt with a red face.
“Like this...?”
“Not that kind of offering!”

(Source: Tencent, translated)

182436.description:
The serious class president is adorably mischievous when it’s just the two of them!

Feeling a bit out of place at home, I’m working part-time in the bustling nightlife. One day, when I helped a girl who was being harassed by a thug… it turned out to be our class president, Yoshino Sara!

“I get tired when I’m always so strict, so sometimes I transform into my true self,” she said.

With a sense of camaraderie, we establish a secret friendship where we can show our true selves to each other.

“But I never expected to be playing rock throwing games with a girl at this age!”
“Come on, it’s fun! Oh, and I want to go to the candy store with you too!”

In truth, Yoshino is innocent and childlike. A ‘little mischievous’ friendship begins where we can just be ourselves!
synonyms: She’s Usually a Serious Class President, But Can She Become Your Girlfriend?

title.romaji: Itsumo wa Majime na Iinchou Dakedo Kimi no Kanojo ni Nareru Kana?

182437.description:
The beautiful student council president is a clumsy girl who’s only perfect on the outside!?

A student council rom-com featuring a self-confident but clumsy heroine!

Nadeshiko Tokigami, the flawless beauty known to everyone at Reishuu Private High School, became the student council president despite being just a first-year student. Meanwhile, Takaki Gunjo, to avoid the risk of repeating a grade, was half-forced into becoming a member of the student council.

If Tokigami is so capable, it’s a perfect chance to slack off by leaving the work to her—or so he thought...

"Pl-Please help me, Gunjo-san!"

Tokigami was actually a seriously clumsy girl whose perfection was only on the surface!? After discovering Tokigami’s true nature, Gunjo took on the role of supporting her to ensure they made it through their terms smoothly. At first, Tokigami hesitated to rely on him, but as they worked together, they gradually grew closer…

A student council rom-com featuring a clumsy but beautiful heroine!
synonyms: The Beautiful Student Council President Tokigami-san Is Clumsy Again Today and Can't Be Left Alone

182440.description:
Yuzuki, a tall but soft-spoken girl, is in love with Akuta, a boy in her class. However, when Akuta was found after school standing in the school hallway wearing a magical girl outfit, he begins to be bullied. Wanting to help Akuta after someone threw a pie at him, Yuzuki chases after him and sees him face to face with a half-fish man.

(Source: Rookie Shonen Jump, translated)

182441.description:
Oh, crud, I just realized that I’ve been reincarnated into my favorite manga as the first boss defeated by the heroine at the start of the story!

Worst yet, it turns out my fiancé is the strongest of the Four Grand Magi and the very villain who slanders my character as a disgrace on her deathbed! I’m outta here!

This is the story of the weakest manga villainess who seeks out the slow life instead of the villain life.

High school student Kogure Ryoma receives love advice from his childhood friend and best friend, Hirasawa Shishi. Although Shishi is quite popular, he was indifferent to romance, so Ryoma is surprised by Shishi's abrupt confession. When he learns that Shishi has feelings for a quiet girl in their class, Ootsuki Shizuku, he decides to help his friend!

While looking into information about Shizuku for Shishi, Ryoma is suddenly called out by the most beautiful girl in school, Asahina Arisa. As Shizuku's best friend, she mistakenly believes that Ryoma has feelings for Shizuku! Due to Arisa's misunderstanding, Ryoma finds himself caught in a whirlwind. As Ryoma and Arisa gradually grow closer, what awaits them at the end of their friendship and budding romance?

This is a youth romantic comedy that begins with friends supporting each other's love!

Su-a, a college freshman in Creative Writing, struggles to understand and express her emotions, leaving her isolated from those around her. When she meets Taeyang, a second-year Sports Coaching student who can sense emotions through touch, their unexpected connection sparks a journey of discovery. Paired for a class assignment that involves a "date," their bond deepens. This is a story about a man who feels too much and a woman who feels too little, and their journey toward emotional growth.

(Source: WEBTOON)

182455.description:
Necromancy has returned to the kingdom of Rahma, and someone is wielding this terrifying forbidden art to shape the kingdom's fate. Conrad, a young knight sworn to the crown, sets out to uncover the necromancer's identity. His investigation leads him to a remote village and a mysterious girl named Luna—whose pale skin, golden hair, and crimson eyes set her apart from everyone around her. Is she the one commanding the dead? And could Luna somehow play a role in Rahma's unraveling?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

182456.description:
Ciudad Juarez is a Mexican city on the border of the United States. In this lawless city, police officer Mori, who is on a drug bust, teams up with elite werewolf Mitsumine to crack down on the powerful sex drug “Lagrimas". While performing their duties, which are always fraught with danger, the two men, who had previously been at odds with each other, gradually begin to come to terms with each other.

Note: Includes the one-shot "Bouzu Ero Kerya Kesa made Eroi (坊主エロけりゃ袈裟までエロい)" previously published in Seifuku x Kinniku BL (制服×筋肉BL), and one extra chapter.

Toma is now in his third year of high school after resetting his twisted relationship with his boyfriend, Sou, who was his whole world. He has a good relationship with his classmate Maki, who gave him the opportunity to break up with Sou, as a best friend with whom he can talk about his true feelings. He is still shaken every time he thinks of Sou, but he decides to face his past with a new encounter. Just then, he meets Sou again, who works as a teacher at the cram school he started attending...?

His days will filled with thrills and turmoil…?

What’s worse than a Karen? A Karen helicopter mom. Doubly so when you’re a teacher who has to deal with her outbursts when her precious boy doesn’t get the best grades.

Tanaka is in that position and getting sick of it. Karen, in his case, is called Takaoka Reiko, a stuck-up ex-model who married into riches. Her pretty face is all she has going for her, so Tanaka snaps and concocts a plan to put her into her place once and for all. With his dick.

My name is Tae-hee... Don't ask me my last name... I'm a very unlucky girl.

(Source: Naver, translated)

182476.description:
Legendary Mangaka Moyuru Hono is Back Again!

The days of risking his life day and night to work on his manuscripts are a thing of the past...

A semi-factual life story of a mangaka and businessman who now struggles not only with his manuscripts but also with his family business!

Many superb guest mangaka appear!

Don't miss the story of the closing of the Hono's bookstore, which became a hot topic on Twitter and various news sites! In addition, Moyuru Hono will appear on a TV variety show! His rivals are popular comedians!!!! Can a mangaka's best story be accepted in the TV industry?

Kazuhiko Shimamoto presents his realistic mangaka fiction on the 40th anniversary of his career!

182477.description: Yuna Yaji is a gourmet girl with a big appetite. She plays a game under the name "Yajuu" and becomes friends with a handsome classmate, Masami Aizawa. However, she hides the fact that she is overweight and sends him a photo of her beautiful sister instead...!?

182480.description:
Neojio is a ‘little great actress’ who used to be very active on the fighting scene.

Note: These characters are the ginjinka of arcade games.

182481.description:
Yoshiki Ryota has three girls with whom he once had a “good vibe.”

- His estranged childhood friend, Nikaidou Remi, from elementary school.
- His easygoing gal friend, Yuzuha Yui.
- His laid-back cram school buddy, Hanazono Yuka.

What if he had mustered the courage to confess back then?

In the spring of his first year of high school, those feelings of regret begin to stir when these four find themselves in the same class!

The girls who once had feelings for Ryota are getting closer to him, seeking to uncover his current feelings in an empty classroom, during an after-school date in the city, and at his home at night!

“I’m glad Ryota is here.”
“I like the time spent with Yoshiki.”
“I wonder if we can be close again.”

Trust, affection, admiration—the feelings they had buried deep inside begin to reignite!?

182482.description:
The drunk senior can't stop saying "I like you!"

I, who had been a loner, recently made a drinking buddy.

The person is Tennouji-senpai, rumored to be the cutest in the university. With excellent grades and stunning looks, she always draws attention and maintains a cool, expressionless demeanor.

"As a lady of the Tennouji family, I must be perfect."

However, it seems that her iron mask starts to peel away when she drinks…

"I found another thing I like about you, Itomori-kun!"
"Uehehhe! You were imagining something naughty, weren't you?" …This is way too defenseless! Just because she’s drunk doesn’t mean everything is allowed!?

"…You're the only one, Itomori-kun, to whom I can show my true self."

A dangerous night begins with this overly bold senior!?
