The Story of How I Helped The Cutest Senior at University and Became Drinking Buddies

title.native: 大学で一番かわいい先輩を助けたら呑み友達になった話
title.romaji: Daigaku de Ichiban Kawaii Senpai wo Tasuketara Nomi Tomodachi ni Natta Hanashi

182484.description:
The more they think it's hopeless, the more they are drawn to each other.

This is a pure love story about a high school boy who falls in love with his deceased brother's fiancée and a woman who projects the image of her beloved onto her fiancée's younger brother. It is a tale of two people who share the same pain, destined for a happy ending.

High school student Nanase Minoru loses his only relative, his older brother, and ends up living under the same roof as his brother's fiancée, Mirumachi Shiho.

As he navigates the delicate distance that makes them neither family nor strangers, Minoru gradually finds healing in Shiho's enveloping kindness. However, feelings that he absolutely should not harbor begin to sprout in his heart, and Shiho, who has also lost her beloved, feels the same…

To become irreplaceable individuals, not mere "substitutes" for each other—this is a story of how their shared sorrow eventually transforms into love.

This pure love story chronicles the days leading to happiness for a high school boy who falls in love with his brother's fiancée and a woman who sees the reflection of her beloved in her fiancée's younger brother.
synonyms: Living Under The Same Roof, I Fell in Love with My Late Brother's Fiancée.

title.native: ひとつ屋根の下、亡兄の婚約者と恋をした。
title.romaji: Hitotsu Yane no Shita, Boukei no Konyakusha to Koi wo Shita.

182486.description: After getting fired from his adventuring clan for his lack of combat ability, Tori wanders around and runs into the city’s strongest adventurer—the White Witch! Since he has nowhere else to go, she hires Tori for his exceptional skill in...handling chores?! With his talent for cooking, cleaning, running errands, and other domestic odd jobs, he’s the perfect fit for taking care of the extremely lazy White Witch and the garbage dump she calls her house. Follow Tori as he grapples with his new job as the caretaker of the beautiful White Witch and her three familiars. Perhaps once he has cleaned up the place, he can finally live a cozy life in the woods with his new employer!

title.english: A Cozy Life in the Woods with the White Witch
title.native: 白魔女さんとの辺境ぐらし　～最強の魔女はのんびり暮らしたい～
title.romaji: Shiromajo-san to no Henkyougurashi: Saikyou no Majo wa Nonbiri Kurashitai

182487.description: At age three, Tafelina Lowell Lera Duval was disowned by her birth parents, but was that actually a blessing in disguise? Raised in a remote region of Ozeria by the kind earl of Peylon, she was allowed to hunt in a forest full of monsters, invent magic tools based on memories of her previous life, and let her extraordinary magical talents flourish. But that all begins to change with the approach of her thirteenth birthday. As the child of a noble, she’s obligated to attend an academy meant to raise and educate the next generation of nobles. That means moving to the royal capital, a sprawling city quite unlike her beloved home. Lera soon feels like a fish out of water, and things only get worse with kidnappings, the appearance of her half sister, and more. But Lera’s not one to be disheartened easily and that isn’t about to change!

title.english: Disowned but Not Disheartened! Life Is Good with Overpowered Magic
title.native: 家を追い出されましたが、元気に暮らしています ～チートな魔法と前世知識で快適便利なセカンドライフ！～
title.romaji: Ie wo Oidasaremashita ga, Genki ni Kurashiteimasu Cheat na Mahou to Zense Chishiki de Kaiteki Benri na Second Life!

182488.description:
The young Count Flood was executed as a corrupt lord, but at the moment of his execution, he time-leaped back into the past.

Having been condemned, one might expect him to reform... but of course, he doesn't.

In his second life, with his sharp-tongued servant by his side, his goal is to live a carefree life as a commoner!

"Future rebel? I'll make them my servant and dump my title on them."

He placates anyone who poses a threat to him...

"A famine? Just eat the potatoes I was eating right before my execution!"

He forces the villagers to eat food that's treated like pig feed...

"An invasion from the neighboring country? I’ll commit treason before they even arrive!"

While indulging in treason and doing as he pleases...

Somehow, his reputation as a virtuous and merciful leader skyrockets!? Praised by saints and princesses alike, and treated as a wise ruler!?

He was supposed to fall to commoner status, so why did things turn out this way!?

A fantasy about a corrupt lord’s mistaken rise to prominence in his second life!
182488.hashtag: #やり直し悪徳領主は反省しない
synonyms: The Corrupt Lord Who Got a Do-Over Doesn't Repent!

title.native: やり直し悪徳領主は反省しない!
title.romaji: Yarinaoshi Akutoku Ryoushu wa Hansei Shinai!

182489.description:
A dream of death was the wake-up call he needed. Lofus Ray Lightless is far from a paragon of virtue. In fact, he revels in his villainy. But a vivid dream of the many ways he's fated to die convinces him that he must change his ways—or at least pretend like he will.

With his trusty butler at his side, Lofus sets forth to turn the tides of fate in his favor so that he can enjoy a long and selfish life. But the future isn't quite what he's seen, and he might have bitten off far more than he can chew...

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: Repeat Vice: The Villainous Noble Gave Up Becoming One of The Four Heavenly Kings Because He Didn't Want To Die

title.english: Repeated Vice: I Refuse to Be Important Enough to Die
title.native: リピート・ヴァイス  ～悪役貴族は死にたくないので四天王になるのをやめました～
title.romaji: Repeat Vice: Akuyaku Kizoku wa Shinitakunai node Shitennou ni Naru no wo Yamemashita

182490.description:
The "Three Most Beautiful Girls in School" that everyone admires—Karasuma Chikage, Ono Tsukasa, and Daigo Sakurako.

For me, Kyosaka Kyo, who is poor and lonely, they seemed like beings from another world... or so I thought, until I saved the three from danger and was fervently liked by them.

"I want to get closer, even by a step. I want to know more about Kyosaka."

What they asked of me was a part-time job to fulfill their requests. I thought it was just simple chores, but it gradually escalated...

"Hey, hug me tightly."
"Shall we kiss?"
"Touch me there, harder."
And after all of that—"It's okay; it's part of the job."

A lovey-dovey life with a wage of 5,000 yen per hour... Is this what being a gigolo is?

"Yes. We want to support you, Kyo-kun."

A school harem gigolo romantic comedy!
synonyms: I’m The Gigolo of The Three Most Beautiful Girls in School

title.native: 校内三大美女のヒモしてます
title.romaji: Kounai Sandai Bijo no Himo Shitemasu

182491.description: After two years of failing, I, Jinnai Umeji, have finally become a university student, but my room is occupied by three beautiful women! While it might sound like a harem filled with indulgence and pleasure to others, unfortunately, all the women here are terrible! There’s the troublemaker, Anase Sakura, who brings chaos with her silly way of speaking; the spice-loving, smoke-addicted tobacco enthusiast, Nekoya Rika; and the cool-headed, all-in gambler, Nishidai Momo. Can I really enjoy a healthy university life with these women—!? This is a moratorium romantic comedy about a lazy university student wasting his youth in a comically complicated way.
synonyms: Komashakureri!! A University Student's Romantic Comedy Is Unbearable When They're Sober and Craving Cigarettes!

title.native: こましゃくれり!!　～大学生のラブコメはシラフでヤニ切れじゃ耐えられない！～
title.romaji: Komashakureri!! Daigakusei no Love Come wa Shirafu de Yani Kire ja Taerarenai!

182492.description:
After a life filled with bullying and power harassment, a 33-year-old man escapes reality by sacrificing sleep to immerse himself in video games, ultimately dying one day.

However, he is chosen as a candidate for reincarnation in another world, but the reincarnation guide tells him he won't receive any cheats.

Instead, he can undergo three months of training at a facility designed for reincarnation preparation. While it's said that acquiring skills at this training facility is relatively easy, one wonders what can be achieved in just three months...

Receiving bonus skills such as appraisal and item box, he begins setting his aptitudes, but time runs out, and he finds himself thrown into the training facility.

To survive in this new life, he dedicates himself desperately to training for three months. However, three months pass, then a year, and then ten years go by without reincarnation. He begins to worry that he might be stuck in a never-ending hell due to dying from playing too many games, yet he continues to train with determination.

Little did he know that the reincarnation process had not been completed due to an error on the part of the guide.

Eventually, after 15 years of training, a sudden reincarnation guide appears.

The man, who has already become a cheat character capable of defeating ancient dragons, devotes himself to enjoying this new world to the fullest.

The protagonist is indecisive, and the characters that appear are often troublemakers.
synonyms: I Became The Strongest In Another World Through The Tutorial Before My Reincarnation. My Second Life Is on Easy Mode Because I Overprepared!

title.native: 転生前のチュートリアルで異世界最強になりました。 準備し過ぎて第二の人生はイージーモードです！
title.romaji: Tensei Mae no Tutorial de Isekai Saikyou ni Narimashita. Junbishi Sugite Daini no Jinsei wa Easy Mode desu!

182493.description:
In a world where sexual roles are reversed, I, who can use rare healing magic, am incredibly popular with women!?

"Please cover your chest!"
"Why would I need to care about covering my chest as a woman!?"

After my clothes were dissolved by a slime, the female adventurer Elmie didn’t hesitate to take off her own clothes and hand them to me, a man.

I was reincarnated into a world where goblins, orcs, and even female thieves don't target women—they target men. In this world of reversed sexual roles, I, an unaware reincarnator, unknowingly raise the affection of the women around me!?

Moreover, I discover that I hold the highest rank in the healer profession, the "Holy Man," the only one capable of using recovery magic. Not only do high-ranking female adventurers start coming after me, but even the queen starts pursuing me!?

A fantasy where I'm relentlessly desired in a world of reversed sexual roles!
synonyms: In a Another World Where The Powers And Virtues of Men And Women Are Reversed, Everyone Comes Seeking Me!

title.native: 男女の力と貞操が逆転した異世界で、誰もが俺を求めてくる件
title.romaji: Danjo no Chikara to Teisou ga Gyakuten Shita Isekai de, Dare mo ga Ore wo Motomete Kuru Ken

182494.description:
"Kei-chan, see you tomorrow!" — That promise was never fulfilled, and young Kirishima Keisuke was separated from his only close male friend, Maa-chan. Then, ten years later, the person who arrived due to their parents' remarriage was none other than Maa-chan—now Masaki—who had grown into a charming and outgoing beautiful girl!

While Keisuke, who had always mistaken her for a boy, is confused, Masaki begins interacting with him even more closely than before, as though they were siblings. Playing games together, eating meals together... and even trying to bathe together!?

As they live together, the two feel a sense of comfort, as if the ten-year gap had never existed. Yet, both their hearts and bodies have grown, and living under the same roof makes them unavoidably aware of each other...!?
synonyms: When I Started Living With My Old Male Friend, It Turned Out He Was Actually a Beautiful Girl: The Distance Between Us is Still as Close as Back Then

title.native: 昔の男友達と同居をはじめたら、実は美少女だった  ～距離感があの頃のままで近すぎる～
title.romaji: Mukashi no Otoko Tomodachi to Doukyo wo Hajimetara, Jitsu wa Bishoujo Datta: Kyori-kan ga Ano Koro no Mama de Chikasugiru

synonyms: I Dug Into My Teacher's Past

title.native: 先生の過去を暴いた話
title.romaji: Sensei no Kako wo Abaita Hanashi

182496.description:
Trained by beautiful heroic spirits, the “Weakest Weapon” evolves into the strongest!

William, who has faced ridicule since childhood and lived a lethargic life, accidentally summons beautiful heroic spirits who made their mark in a war a thousand years ago!?

“Let me grant you power that transcends everything. However, you must become our disciple.”

William finds himself forced into intense training he never asked for, drawing out his magical abilities under the tutelage of Iris, the heroic spirit and demon lord...

Suddenly casting magic without incantation!?
There’s no opening in his sword stance...!!

To everyone’s surprise, he possesses remarkable talent in both magic and swordsmanship! Once he gains unparalleled strength at the magic academy, he becomes the focus of admiration from his childhood friend, who is the best in the school in both looks and ability, and his classmates' opinions of him change completely!

The story of the boy once considered the “Weakest Weapon” and his dramatic reversal of fortune begins now!
synonyms: I Was Raised by a Group of Beautiful Heroic Spirits and Became Humanity's Ace

title.native: 美少女揃いの英霊に育てられた俺が人類の切り札になった件
title.romaji: Bishoujo Soroi no Eirei ni Sodaterareta Ore ga Jinrui no Kirifuda ni Natta Ken

182497.description:
I’ve been reincarnated as the villain in a game I mastered!? Use knowledge of the original story to dominate and forge new routes!

I reincarnated into the bishoujo game Gakuen Kagurazaka that I played alot—as the villainous noble, Titan, who has zero talent with a sword and can’t use any skills. Worse yet, in every route, I’m destined to die in the end.

But I have complete knowledge of this world! By breaking every death flag and forging ahead on my own path, I suddenly find myself surrounded by heroines on a harem route!?

- Sian, a cheerful and slightly sheltered princess.
- Chrono, a quiet and cool-headed maid.
- Furu, the petite but caring school nurse.

From a villainous noble doomed to a bad end, I’ll use my expert knowledge to dominate and carve out a new route! The bishoujo game reincarnation fantasy begins!
synonyms: Break the Death Flags by Force! I Reincarnated as the Villain in an Eroge, And After Using My Knowledge of The Original Story to Overpower Everyone, I Ended Up With a Harem

title.native: ～死亡フラグは力でへし折れ！～ エロゲの悪役に転生したので、原作知識で無双していたらハーレムになっていました
title.romaji: Shibou Flag wa Chikara de Heshiore! Eroge no Akuyaku ni Tensei Shita node, Gensaku Chishiki de Musou Shiteitara Harem ni Natteimashita

synonyms: A Girl That Can See Ghosts

182499.description:
His step-sister Erika, whom he reunites with for the first time in seven years after their divorced parents reconciled with each other, and his childhood friend Mio, who feels like a close male friend to him despite being a girl.

Katsuragi Shota ends up living under the same roof with the two of them.

“...Is this what it’s like to be siblings?”
“If we were really siblings, would we act like this?”

The three of them, each having experienced loneliness related to family, find a comfort that feels more familial than that of strangers.

However, to avoid romantic troubles at their high school, Mio and Shota decide to pretend to be a fake couple, leading them to unexpectedly become aware of each other as the “opposite sex”...!?

As the three non-blood-related individuals search for a way to become a family, they navigate feelings that go beyond mere familial ties in this cohabitation romantic comedy.
synonyms: The Only Way We Can Become Family Even Though We Aren't Related By Blood

title.native: 血の繋がらない私たちが家族になるたった一つの方法
title.romaji: Chi no Tsunagaranai Watashitachi ga Kazoku ni Naru Tatta Hitotsu no Houhou

182500.description:
“Whoa! Kutsuzawa-kun, you’re amazing!”

I never expected this to happen.

On my usual way home, while walking alone as always, I encounter the class’s most beautiful gal nearly tipping over on her bicycle. I manage to help her and fix her bike, thinking I could just leave it at that… but she looked at me with sparkling eyes.

This incident leads her to take a liking to me, and as we get involved in various activities, my mundane daily life begins to change.

This is a pure love story between a naive gal at the top of the class hierarchy and a socially awkward boy who loves making things.
synonyms: After I Fixed a Gal's Bicycle, She Became Fond of Me

title.native: ギャルの自転車を直したら懐かれた
title.romaji: Gal no Jitensha wo Naoshitara Natsukareta

182501.description:
“Men who get caught between yuri should die!”

That’s my creed. My daily routine is to secretly support the beautiful girl couples in my class from the shadows. …Or at least it was supposed to be, but my attempts at being a shadowy supporter have been exposed, and now I’m getting way too close to them!? Am I, perhaps, getting caught in between?? But, this isn’t yuri to begin with.
synonyms: My Popularity Is Misunderstood: I Got Caught Between My Favorite Beautiful Girls

title.native: 俺がモテるのは解釈違い　～推し美少女たちに挟まれました～
title.romaji: Ore ga Moteru no wa Kaishaku Chigai: Oshi Bishoujo-tachi ni Hasamaremashita

182502.description:
“Why is everyone misunderstanding things like this…?”

Through a twist of fate, the protagonist, Kai, finds himself reincarnated as a mob villain slave trader in the RPG world he was deeply playing.

If he follows the game’s scenario, he’s fated for destruction, but by chance, he ends up rescuing the heroines who were captured and delivers them to the town using the items he accumulated before his reincarnation.

“There’s no doubt he’s a seasoned warrior.”
“I must express my gratitude for what you’ve done!”
“You’re truly a wonderful person. I want to get to know you better.”


As a result, despite being just a mob character who shouldn't be strong, misunderstandings spread due to the knowledge he used from the game――.

Having reincarnated as a villain mob, he begins to be adored by the heroines!
synonyms: I Was Reincarnated as a Villain Mob in The Game World I Was Obsessed With: Using Game Knowledge to Live Freely, My Name Somehow Became Known Everywhere

title.native: やり込んでいたゲーム世界の悪役モブに転生しました　～ゲーム知識使って気ままに生きてたら、何故かありとあらゆる所で名が知れ渡っていた～
title.romaji: Yarikon de Ita Game Sekai no Akuyaku Mob ni Tensei Shimashita: Game Chishiki Tsukatte Kimama ni Ikitetara, Nazeka Ari to Arayuru Tokoro de Na ga Shirawatatteita

182503.description:
The MC is summoned to a matriarchal society. Due to his massive penis, he is enslaved by a baroness. Can our MC live a happy life by dominating high class women in this female-dominated world?

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)
synonyms: Taming Females to Rise in Status
貞操逆転世界でメスを攻略して成り上がる

title.native: 立てば芍薬 座れば牡丹 歩く姿はボケマ○コ
title.romaji: Tateba Shakuyaku, Suwareba Botan, Aruku Sugata wa Boke Manko

182505.description:
Hachisuke is a cat humanoid living in a world where humans and cats coexist. But Hachisuke is withdrawn and has difficulty being loved by humans. After all, cats are still treated as cute “objects” for humans. See the world through Hachisuke’s eyes as he tries to fit into modern society and endure the prejudice that comes with being different.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.native: 黒人様の極太チンポで堕ちた人妻
title.romaji: Kokujin-sama no Kyokutai Chinpo de Ochita Hitozuma

182507.description:
Every antique object contains unforgettable yearnings…

In an alleyway of an old city hides a mysterious antique store, where people trade the souls of objects.

"Welcome!"

The shop owner, Rosetta, has shockingly colorful hair and a slender, curvy figure. In stark contrast to her antiques, she is young and beautiful. It is said she can tell you the stories and memories behind any object you hand her. Here, we learn the stories of an old fountain pen, imbued with a sense of madness and tragedy. A neglected portrait, reveals unrequited feelings from decades ago.

Every object has an immortalized soul, born from unforgettable events and sentiments from the past…

(Source: Gaea Books, translated)

title.romaji: Luo Saita: Shiguang De Xuan Xu Diao

182508.description:
In the alleys of the old city, there is a mysterious antique shop. It is said that the shop-owner Rosetta can tell you the stories and memories behind any object you hand her…

The necklace in the cabinet, tells the story of a young actress's mad obsession with performing.

Fang Meiling was a child actress, hoping to become an adult professional. After she successfully starred in a stage adaptation of the biblical tale of Salome, she found her acting career stalled once again. Uncomfortable questions from her family and friends turned her passion for acting into anxiety over her talent, as she lost herself in the abyss of jealousy and obsession, leading to a dramatic end…

(Source: Gaea Books, translated)

title.romaji: Luo Saita: Sheng Yan Yu Jin

182509.description:
Hazakura Furukawa is the most popular girl in class due to her conservative attire and pure, innocent appearance, like a literary character. On the other hand, I'm a guy who is shunned because of my lazy demeanor and unkempt appearance that makes me seem like "a guy who hits on girls," even though that's not what I'm really like. But then, Hazakura said, "Rihito-kun made me a real woman!" And with those words, Hazakura transformed herself completely!

"Rihito-kun is stylish, cool, and stays true to yourself without caring about what others say… You're exactly the kind of guy I like!" Although I was embarrassed at first, Hazakura maintained her new, bold attitude, saying, "I just want to experience love like everyone else."

As my relationship with her deepens, the way the class treats me also starts to change!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: Sorry! It's My Fault the Popular Literature Girl in Class Shortened Her Skirt

title.native: すまん！ クラスで人気の文学少女がスカートを短くしたのはオレのせいだ
title.romaji: Suman! Class de Ninki no Bungaku Shoujo ga Skirt wo Mijikaku Shita no wa Ore no Sei da

182510.description:
"Is this really Joseon?! Even so, we must save lives!"

Baek Gang-Hyeok, South Korea's greatest genius surgeon. After touching a mysterious painting, he falls into Joseon. And of all times... right before the outbreak of the Imjin War!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

182511.description:
In a brutal medieval world where innocence means life and guilt means death, Aron, captain of the castle guard, enforces order within the fortress. But when demons begin to corrupt men’s hearts, violent events erupt, including repeated attempts to assassinate the lady of the castle. As Aron hunts the culprits, he encounters a demon that marks him, granting incredible strength but tainting his body with dark magic. Now, with his mind clouded and powers growing, Aron must unravel the mystery before the castle and his soul fall to ruin.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: A Rogue Guard in a Medieval Fantasy
ผู้พิทักษ์เถื่อนแห่งยุคกลาง

title.english: The Roguish Guard in a Medieval Fantasy

182512.description:
To save her noble family from a massive 100 million debt, Ariana Astaroth marries the wealthy commoner Rowen Green, making him the new Count Astaroth in exchange. But after five years of marriage, he impregnates her best friend, and Ariana demands a divorce, stating that she'll pay him back. She goes to a guild run by a man named Rowen for help, who promises to help her escape the marriage. Can Ariana divorce her disloyal husband, or will the overwhelming debt crush her in the end?

(Source: Tapas)

182513.description:
Hye-Seong, a boy living on a remote island, and Yun-Hae, a mysterious mermaid, become each other’s only friend. But soon after they meet, they’re separated after Hye-Seong moves away. Six years later, Yun-Hae develops a mysterious power and finds Hye-Seong again. Unfortunately, too much has changed, and Hye-Seong can no longer dedicate all his time to her as he did in their childhood. He tells her they are too different, but Yun-Hae’s attachment to Hye-Seong slowly transforms into an obsession...

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

182514.description:
Chang-Gyeon, the bastard third son, clawed his way to the throne in a whirlwind of chaos and blood. Now, with his reign spiraling out of control and the kingdom teetering on the edge, his only comfort lies in one person—his childhood friend, Sam-Myeong. But what started as fondness has twisted into something darker. Chang-Gyeon’s obsession knows no bounds, and he’s willing to do anything—schemes, manipulation, even breaking Sam-Myeong’s will—to keep him close.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: แรงรักแรงสิเน่หา

182515.description:
In the oppressive city of Detroit, Akio is sold by his dad and becomes an assassin known as Snake. Day after day, he simply follows orders. But suddenly, he meets a blind girl and finds new meaning in life...!

(Source: MANGA plus)

182516.description:
Life's never quiet when you've got S-Rank Rizz.
Former S-Rank Hunter Ui-Jae, a.k.a. J, saved humanity from eldritch horrors emerging from dimensional rifts, only to time-leap 8 years into a future where he's presumed dead. Now a manager at a hangover soup joint, all J wants is a quiet life. But between selling off the relics of his past and catching the obsessive attention of Korea's #1 Hunter Sa-Yeong, peace isn't on the menu!

(Source: Manta, edited)
synonyms: The Hunter Wants to Live Quietly

182517.description:
Raymon has it all: perfect looks, a prestigious family, and unrivaled abilities in the workplace. But beneath his flawless exterior lies a chaotic love life, with a string of unsatisfying, fleeting encounters. His search for the perfect partner ends when a janitor named Winter seemingly saves him from a stalker's attack. Drawn to Winter’s striking looks and submissive nature, Raymon proposes a FWB situation, to which Winter eagerly agrees. At first, their relationship seems ideal, but Raymon soon realizes the terrifying truth - Winter has been his stalker all along. Now trapped in a deadly game, Raymon finds himself pretending to love Winter in a desperate bid to survive. Winter, unhinged and obsessively devoted, will stop at nothing - even murder - to keep Raymon all to himself. And so begins a dangerous, seductive battle of control, where love and dominance blur into a deadly obsession.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.
synonyms: Control Time：コントロール・タイム

182518.description:
Bellia, the unfortunate Grand Duchess fated to die at the hands of her dangerous husband, planned to endure her loveless marriage just long enough to get a divorce. But before she could leave, one unexpected night changes everything.

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: I Spent the Night With My Husband Who's Planning to Divorce

title.english: One Last Night With My Soon-to-Be Ex-Husband

182519.description:
"If you think of me as a man, I'll gladly become a man!"

Lee Cho-Hee, an unlucky female idol trainee who is always eliminated from the debut group because of her boyish appearance! She thought it was her last chance and applied for the idol audition survival show "High Teen Universe"... but there was a problem with her gender(?) A fresh and precarious story of love and friendship between trainees!

(Source: Naver, translated)

182520.description:
After marrying her dream man and ascending the throne, Empress Adrisa seems to have everything. But, no matter what she tries, she can’t capture the emperor’s heart. Emperor Rothbart never forgave Adrisa for the conniving that brought her to his side, tormenting his wife as revenge for his fate. But in a parallel world, the couple’s destiny is far different. On the brink of madness after the loss of his wife, there is another Emperor Rothbart who would do anything to be close to Adrisa again.

(Source: Tapas)

182521.description:
In this game world, levels and skills are everything; but unfortunately for Ayine, she’s been stuck at level 7 for a while. To make matters worse, she ends up getting an S-level curse after an encounter with a rare malignant spirit. Though her curse does not manifest physically, it causes excruciating pain at night. In desperation, she consults with a priest only to be told that she must either pay a high fee for purification or sleep with a knight with strong divine power or drink their blood. Despite her bleak future, Ayine is determined to find a knight who can lift her curse.

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: お慈悲をください勇者様!! ～キスだけじゃ呪いは解けない～

182522.description:
"I can't remember someone important who was always beside me."

Houri, who lives a very ordinary life, is drawn to a crosswalk and almost gets run over by a truck, but is saved by a man who passes by. The moment he sees the man's face, he has flashbacks of his past life, when the two of them were intimate. The two are led by a super-powerful fate to make love, but the next morning, the man declares that he doesn't remember Houri...!? A story of love that returns until death do them part.

(Source: Libre, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 君と生きられるなら死んでもいい
title.romaji: Kimi to Ikirareru nara Shindemo ii

182523.description:
Kagomiya Mikado is the noble son of the Kagomiya group. On the way to a matchmaking meeting that his father forced him to attend, Mikado was suddenly sucked into a big hole. What spread in front of him was vast scenery with weird plants he’s never seen in his life… Which means Mikado was hurled into another world…!! He was attacked blindly by tentacles and was ready to die when the tough, brave knight Abel appeared. What on earth was the reason Mikado was brought to this world…?!

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

182524.description:
Luna is a charismatic idol who dreams of going solo but is unexpectedly forced to form a new unit with a rising star named Hyou. Luna, who is fastidious, an insomniac, and somewhat tsundere, finds living with the energetic Hyou to be a nightmare at first. To make matters more complicated, Hyou boldly confesses that he fell in love with Luna at first sight. As Luna navigates the challenges of their partnership, he can't help but be intrigued by Hyou's unwavering affection, despite the chaos it brings to his meticulously ordered life. Behind the scenes, a complex relationship unfolds, revealing the struggles and secrets of a perfect star cherished by a dog-like younger idol.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 溺愛パーフェクトスター

182525.description:
Having grown up in a divorced family, university student Kokoro believes that “love is lighter than chopsticks” and finds himself a bit more sexually active than others. What he enjoys most is indulging in “dirty things” every day with his senior and roommate, Toru, who understands him better than anyone. With Toru in his life, Kokoro feels fulfilled and even sleeps soundly. However, everything changes when Toru suddenly declares that he won't touch Kokoro anymore! Frustrated and sleepless, Kokoro finds himself in a desperate situation...

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

title.native: 心くんは愛とかいらない

182526.description:
Mini is a “Scum Detective,” and her latest job is from a rich girl who wants to test her boyfriend’s loyalty. However, her boyfriend, Zhao Yueming, acts like a straightforward gentleman, and Mini’s usual methods don’t work on him. This turns out to be a little tricky for Mini, who is more used to dealing with scummy "playboys." This game of back-and-forth between the womanizer and the one who understands them best is about to begin. Who will fall into the love trap first?!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.
synonyms: Did you reveal your secret today?!

182527.description:
Luka lives in a snowy village deep in the mountains alongside a beastkin man named Werk. Werk expresses his affection towards him freely without a care. Luka, on the other hand, feels guilty about being unable to return his feelings, while still allowing himself to indulge in Werk's desires, as the sensation of human warmth put him at ease. While he certainly feels love towards Werk, Luka's tragic past holds him back from accepting his feelings in full...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: さよならの、その時まで

182528.description:
After five years, Vivian Summer makes a triumphant return with her daughter. No longer the miserable girl blinded by love, she crushes both her ex-husband, who came begging for reconciliation, and his former flame when she came to provoke her. Yet even as her heart is filled with glee, she finds herself hounded by a magnate, and her own baby girl keeps calling the man daddy…

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: I Bring My Kid to Blow Up My Ex Husband's House

title.romaji: Wo Xie Youzai Zha Fan Qianfu Jia

182530.description:
Sin-Bi, a piano prodigy, has been harmonizing with Tae-Ui, a genius boy soprano, for a long time. One day, Tae-Ui suddenly leaves to study abroad, and Sin-Bi, a piano prodigy who returns to being an ordinary student, begins a competition challenge after a dramatic reunion of two high school students five years later.

(Source: Naver, translated)

182532.description:
Every hundred years, the Monster’s Bride is chosen — a sacrifice given to the demonic creature confined somewhere within the country. When Stella’s sister is chosen, she volunteers to go in her place. Stella is soon sent to be the bride of the blood-soaked vampire Lavi. But behind the blood and fangs, Stella finds this monster harbors a deep loneliness. Will her affections pull him out of his deadly despair, or is their love cursed from the start?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: Ton étoile filante cachante le fleurs

title.native: 花秘める君のメテオール

182533.description:
A world where immortals born 1,600 years ago (Blue Dragon, White Tiger, Red Bird, Black Tortoise, Yellow Dragon) coexist with humans. Eun-Hwa, an ordinary graduate student whose only dreams are of passing her thesis and having a crush on her senior, becomes the butler of the reclusive god of death, Black Tortoise.

(Source: Naver, translated)

182534.description:
During junior high, Shirayuki Yume was obsessed with imaginary "dream boyfriends," and she would write romantic stories about them in her notebook. Now in her thirties, living an ordinary life as an office lady, her long-forgotten imaginary ex-boyfriends suddenly start appearing before her...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 白雪友芽とn人の夢彼氏
title.romaji: Shirayuki Yume to n-nin no Yume Kareshi

182535.description:
Kotori Yamada is a sunny but plain high school girl, who is friends with Tsubaki, her childhood friend who is as pretty as a red rose, and Akiomi, the handsome prince of the school. Alongside her gorgeous friends, Kotori always gets overshadowed and overlooked. One day, Kotori comes across another girl confessing to Akiomi, who rejects her by saying that he already someone he likes. Kotori assumes that it must be Tsubaki, but in fact, Akiomi has feelings for Kotori…

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 花はことりを好きすぎる
title.romaji: Hana wa Kotori wo Suki Sugiru

182536.description: A one-shot about a trio of childhood friends.

182537.description: The person I once admired has fallen ill and is now drowning in alcohol..
synonyms: The tyrant who has only a short time to live

title.native: 余命わずかの暴君さまは

182538.description: Murasaki, who's always busy studying, suddenly gets an invitation to a Halloween party from his quirky twin classmates.

182539.description:
King Wilfred is feared as the “Brutal and Tyrannical Demon King.” Alicia, a princess raised among commoners, was betrothed to him in a political marriage. Though initially intimidated by Wilfred’s stoic and imposing nature, Alicia slowly discovers the clumsy kindness hidden beneath his icy exterior. As Alicia’s sunny, open-hearted personality begins to warm his lonely heart, what started as a bumpy political marriage turns into a unique romance!

(Source: Manga UP!)
synonyms: Until the Solitary King and the Sunshine Bride Become the Happiest Couple

title.english: The Lonely King and His Sunshine Bride’s Happily Ever After
title.native: 孤高の王と陽だまりの花嫁が最幸の夫婦になるまで
title.romaji: Kokou no Ou to Hidamari no Hanayome ga Saikou no Fuufu ni Naru made

182540.description:
A story about a high school girl and her college-aged tutor!!

(Source: Twitter, translated)

Note: Originally published in the 2019 Feb. issue of the Betsufure NEXT supplemental.

title.native: 問一、この気持ちの名前は？
title.romaji: Toi Ichi, Kono Kimochi no Namae wa?

182541.description:
"I've been trying to hold back, until now."

Marianna, the daughter of an earl, married Gerard, the heir of a prestigious ducal family.

However, there is one big problem for Marianna...
She is hopelessly naive!

She faints from embarrassment when a man even walks next to her, let alone touches her hand, so she had given up hope for a happy marriage. But for the sake of Gerard, who proposed to her so sincerely, Marianna wants to fulfill her proper role as his wife on their wedding night.

After finishing her preparations, she will finally go to bed――…!?

(Source: Muteki Renai S*Girl, translated)

title.native: 純真花嫁の甘すぎ初夜レッスン 公爵様に触れたいんです…！
title.romaji: Junshin Hanayome no Amasugi Shoya Lession Koushaku-sama ni Furetai ndesu!

182542.description:
Uesugi Kage is a second-year high school girl. When she's suddenly notified that her apartment building is going to get torn down, she is at a loss for what to do. So she asks to meet with her landlord to see if they might be able to offer a solution.

Elf and JK, living together with a 1,000-year age difference.

(Source: Mystery Bonita, translated)

title.native: エルフとひとつ屋根の下

182543.description:
Yuuta and Akane have the house all to themselves with the parents away on business. Akane's been a little too relaxed when hanging around the house and it's driving Yuuta wild. When it gets to be too much, he decides to take a chance and make a move!

(Source: Irodori Comics)

Note: Released at Comiket 96.
synonyms: My Stepsis Is So Sexy That It's a Problem for Me!

title.english: I Can't Help It! My Sis Is Too Sexy!
title.native: 僕の姉さんがえろすぎて困ってますっ!
title.romaji: Boku no Nee-san ga Erosugite Komattemasu!

182559.description:
The second spin-off of the peak hentai doujinshi manga Karami Zakari on Yanmaga! This time, the main character is Takeshi, a virgin college boy who loves to read Karami Zakari. Takeshi tries to save a girl who looks like Takeuchi-senpai from getting corrupted by a delinquent, but he gets beat up and pushed into a truck instead. When he wakes up, he is reborn as Takashi, the MC of Karami Zakari! Although he's excited to be in the world of his beloved story, is he going to play out his story like the scumbag character?

(Source: Yanmaga, translated)

title.native: カラミざかRe: 転生したら坊主だったDT
title.romaji: Karami Zakari Re:Tensei Shitara Bouzu Datta DT

182560.description:
"Brace yourself, Protagonist. With this power, I will create a new future."

When I realized it, I was in the world of my favorite romance RPG. However, I was reincarnated as Harold, the "Useless Evil Prince," who breaks off the heroine's engagement and meets a disastrous ending. Moreover, due to the setting, I cannot use magic at all and was just a minor character who gets defeated by the protagonist.

But it is different this time. First, I will stop the engagement cancellation with the heroine and begin focusing on my own development. Additionally, I will acquire weapons different from those in the original story and use my vast magic power that I couldn’t utilize before to overwhelm my foes! In my pursuit of strength, I inadvertently become a figure of interest to other heroines as well...
synonyms: The Survival of an Incompetent Villainous Prince: I Was Reincarnated as a Villain Mob in a Romance RPG, but I Will Aim to be the Strongest While Ignoring the Original Story

title.native: 無能の悪童王子は生き残りたい　～恋愛ＲＰＧの悪役モブに転生したけど、原作無視して最強を目指す～
title.romaji: Munou no Akudou Ouji wa Ikinokoritai: Renai RPG no Akuyaku Mob ni Tensei Shita Kedo, Gensaku Mushi Shite Saikyou wo Mezasu

title.native: あきのよさこのめっちゃいい感じ
title.romaji: Aki no Yosa Kono Meccha Ii Kanji

synonyms: That I've become the kind of girl my geek friends like.

title.native: オタク友達の好みの女の子になってしまった件
title.romaji: Otaku Tomodachi no Konomi no Onnanoko ni Natte Shimatta Ken

182566.description:
The young bossy school monkey had dreams of becoming a human being?!

(Source: Kodansha)

182567.description:
"From today you are mine. Serve me well." Harunada, the son of the dragon god, visits the youkai brothel Kasumirou, whose workers specialize in taking human shape, looking to hire a prostitute who looks like his mother, hoping to calm his father after the death of his human wife. Harunada himself is not interested in the human concept of "love," however, on his way home he finds a human, Chika, injured in the forest. For some reason, he can't ignore the presence of that human, who hates supernatural beings after a loved one was attacked by youkai. Harunada makes Chika his servant, but... A Japanese-style fantasy BL about a young man with unrequited feelings, and a noble dragon cub who wants to understand love.

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

182568.description:
The year is 20XX in Tsuchiura City, Ibaraki Prefecture. In this city where the surface of the Kasumigaura River gently undulates, one of Japan's most militant armed groups, the “New Exclusionist Society,” appears. They occupy a bank and declare a massacre of hostages. The citizens are helpless in the face of this unreasonable violence. The three men who are fighting back are Museki Mugo, a righteous man whose name is no less than that of the Tsuchiura Police Department's “Suicide Attack Section,” Eita Sakimori, a windbag gangster, and Natsuki Tamimori, an ordinary man with an unworthy destiny. For the sake of the “justice” they believe in, a hero show full of quirky characters is about to begin!

(Source : Kodansha, translated)

182569.description:
1. Hotaru no Izumi (ほたるの泉)
2. Noibara Souen (野イバラ荘園)

Note: Contains the illustrated short story Page 1 (ページ１).
synonyms: Top Lady Color Series: Ooshima Yumiko
Top Lady Color Series: Oshima Yumiko

title.native: Top Lady Color Series　大島弓子
title.romaji: Top Lady Colour Series: Ooshima Yumiko

182570.description:
Asaoka is a delinquent who rules over his high school. His crony, a quiet classmate named Saji, has no talents and has no friends. Asaoka usually looks down on Saji, until one day, when Asaoka's one word changes their relationship...

(Source: Shinchosa, translated)

182571.description:
Kazunobu Haramoto is all about that thug life. He’s rough-and-tumble, and now that he’s joined the yakuza, he’s all set to climb the ranks of the underworld. But you know what they say: All conditioned things are like dreams, shadows, and bubbles. And Kazunobu’s bubble bursts like no other! A gang raid by a mysterious assassin leaves all his new yakuza comrades dead and dusted, and the fuzz catch him at the scene with the only other survivor, the boss’s young daughter. Witness protection is his and the girl’s best hope now—and for some reason, the cops have it in their heads that a strict and prestigious Zen Buddhist temple is the best place for them to hide! Kazunobu’s got two options: death or Nirvana!

(Source: Yen Press)

182572.description:
In this action-packed isekai, one gamer finds himself reincarnated in his favorite academy game—but as the villain! Can he change the game and avoid complete ruin?

I don’t know how it happened, but somehow I’ve died and reincarnated into my favorite academy game. And if that wasn’t weird enough, I’m now the depraved and lazy villain, Weiss Fansent, whose misdeeds lead him to a deadly end. Something I’m determined to avoid at all costs. With little time left until the academy’s entrance exams, I have no choice but to dive headfirst into serious and grueling training. Which means swordsmanship with the S-rank adventurer Miruku Abitas, followed by intense magic practice. It was demanding and exhausting, but getting stronger means I have a better chance of avoiding my disastrous end.

But I seriously underestimated just how powerful Weiss truly is, and I wind up stunning everyone at the exams! Have I somehow become more powerful than the hero?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: Reincarnated as a Lazy Disgraceful Aristocrat, I Rewrote the Scenario and Became the Strongest with Unparalleled Magic

title.english: Reborn as an Aristocratic Scoundrel, I Broke the Game and Mastered Magic Beyond Limits!
title.native: 怠惰な悪辱貴族に転生した俺、シナリオをぶっ壊したら規格外の魔力で最凶になった
title.romaji: Taida na Akujoku Kizoku ni Tensei Shita Ore, Scenario wo Bukkowa Shitara Kikaku-gai no Maryoku de Saikyou ni Natta

182573.description:
In Tokyo, where dungeons have appeared, a poor college student, Tombo, suddenly awakens to a skill... It's the divine skill of 'Cosmic Trading,' which allows him to exchange items from faraway space with items from Earth!

Together with Mars, a space cat exchanged for orange peels, he starts a business to get some quick cash—and it becomes a huge hit with dungeon adventurers, quickly growing into something bigger…!?

Through a series of trades, he somehow even acquires beautiful girls!?

And he might even get his hands on a giant robot, a man's ultimate dream…?
synonyms: The Straw Millionaire, Cat, and Princess: A Rise to Power with Earth and Cosmic Trading Skills!? President! Hero? ...Space Pirate!?

title.native: わらしべ長者と猫と姫　～宇宙と地球の交易スキルで成り上がり!?　社長！　英雄？　……宇宙海賊!?～
title.romaji: Warashibe Chouja to Neko to Hime: Uchuu to Chikyuu no Koueki Skill de Nariagari!? Shachou! Eiyuu?…Uchuu Kaizoku!?

182574.description:
Akiko, 33, runs a general store by herself. Just as she was getting tired of the grind of managing the business, she finds herself living together with a funky old lady who popped out of a cardboard box on the street…?

(Source: Flowers, translated)

182575.description:
In the world of card games, it's pretty common for the world to be destroyed by them.

I, Tanahuda Mitsuru, reincarnated into such a world and finally achieved my dream of becoming the manager of a card shop.

In this world where people enjoy card battles, I just wanted to watch them up close. However, from the outside, I seem to look like the previous manager, who has solved many major problems and watched over the children as a leader. But, In reality, I’ve never solved any major problems at all.

This is the story of a reincarnated person who, after becoming the manager of a card shop in a world where card games are prioritized above all else, is mistakenly believed by those around him to be the previous manager who has solved major incidents in the past—when that’s definitely not the case.
synonyms: When I Reincarnated into a World Where Card Games Destroy the World and Opened a Card Shop, Everyone Around Me Thinks I'm the Previous Manager

title.native: カードゲームで世界が滅ぶ世界に転生してカードショップを開店したら、周囲から前作主人公だと思われている
title.romaji: Card Game de Sekai ga Horobu Sekai ni Tensei Shite Card Shop wo Kaiten Shitara, Shuui kara Zensaku Shujinkou da to Omowareteiru

182576.description:
Sera, a sexually curious salaryman, has newly set his sights on Ryo, a new employee at his favourite bar.
He tries to talk to him about sex, a new kind of pleasure, but Ryo is popular with men and women of all ages and has a lot of experience.
Because Sera keeps pestering him, Ryo gets mad and teaches him about the pleasures of the backside...

(Source: Core Magazine, translated)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.
synonyms: 차려진 밥상은 먹는 게 남자의 본성

title.native: 据え膳喰らうは男のタチ
title.romaji: Suezen Kurau wa Otoko no Tachi

synonyms: The Daily Life at Chinese Restaurant VALIS

182580.description:
No new clothes for a whole year?!

After finding out her rent is going to increase, Ji-Na Yun decides it's time for her to move. But wait... She's broke because she spent all her money on clothes! Join Ji-Na on her year-long challenge to not buy any new clothing. Will she be able to end her addiction to shopping?

(Source: Manta, edited)

182581.description:
"The neighbors are suspicious"

Apartment 3 values ​​the friendship between neighbors. They force them to be friendly, but the main character's family refuses, and after that, the neighbors start to suffocate them.

(Source: Naver, translated)

182582.description:
After being ripped from the spiritual world and implanted in a doll by sorcerers, Perrie's only wish is to return to the afterlife. But when dying proves to be impossible with her current indestructible body, she encounters the Demon King, who suggests that his son Julian is capable of giving her the death she desires. The only catch? She has to raise and protect him from other demons who want the throne! Will Perrie get what she wants, or will death always be out of reach for her?

(Source: Tapas)

182583.description:
Ensnared in a dark ploy by both her stepmother and half-sister, Eris was forced to marry the useless and pathetic Gellert. Her married life was rife with difficulties, yet she endured the insults and agony to raise her beloved son, Luka.

But when her husband’s carelessness led to Luka’s death, Gellert tried to comfort Eris by saying, “We’re still young. We can have more children.”

Devastated by his words, Eris prayed to the heavens, begging to have her son back. Moved by her plight, the Golden Dragon manifested his powers to bring Eris back to the day when this all started. Eris was determined to have her revenge against her stepmother, her half-sister, and her ex-husband, but…

“Do the rumors about us upset you?”

Teodore Lehinal, a Duke that Eris had never even spoken to in her last life, seemed to have taken a sudden interest in her…

(Source: Pocket Comics)

title.english: A Golden Fate That Transcends Time
title.native: 黒幕の公爵が契約結婚を提案しました
title.romaji: Kuromaku no Koushaku ga Keiyaku Kekkon wo Teian Shimashita

182584.description:
After seven years trapped in the Devil Grand Duke’s dungeon, Luculia is finally free, but her savior is not the prince she imagined. Davierre Montefeltro, a temperamental duke, unexpectedly takes her in. As Luculia adjusts to life outside the dungeon, mysteries swirl around Duke Davierre’s intentions. Can Luculia find happiness at last, or is this new life just another dungeon?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Secrets of the Lovely Duchess

title.english: The Secret of the Lovely Duchess

182585.description:
Celebrating failure.

Feeling like a failure after giving up her lifelong dream, Kkang-Jang travels to Iceland, a country where failure is embraced — and also one of the most expensive places in the world. Can she make her journey work on a shoestring budget? Follow along as she travels with the help of a guardian spirit!

(Source: Manta)

182586.description:
The main character, who worked every day like a corporate slave, woke up one day to find herself as "Lady Christina," a noble lady of another world. According to the memories she inherited from her new body, Christina was an evil woman riddled with red flags! Warned by the prince that this is her last chance to redeem herself, she is even forced to live with the duke's son to prevent her from causing any more harm. The duke's son is seeking an excuse to execute her, so Christina resolves to work hard to avoid further tarnishing her reputation. However, it appears there are other reasons why he wants to keep a close watch on her... Immerse yourself in the romantic fantasy between a former villainess, who has committed every conceivable sin, and the vigilant duke who has his eyes on her!

(Source: Pocket Comics)

title.english: I Woke Up as a Notorious Troublemaker!
title.native: せっかく令嬢に憑依したのにすでにやらかした後でした！
title.romaji: Sekkaku Reijou ni Hyoui Shita no ni Sude ni Yarakashita Nochi deshita!

182588.description:
Irene Song had transmigrated inside a novel and became the villainous daughter of a duke. However, the Duke, who was unaware of this fact, simply thought she had amnesia and sends her off to marry the second prince of Rennes Empire. Little did she know that the second prince was cursed by an evil wizard and turned him into a dog during the day and could only turn back to a human at night. What’s worse, she even named it “Tofu” after she found it wandering in the Imperial Palace. Who would have known it was her own husband!

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: The Duke's Villainous Daughter Is Depressed

182589.description:
Yumi, an actress with no experience in love, is terrified when she wakes up in a dark romance as Selene Belias on her wedding night! Yet instead of confining her like in the novel, her husband, "Monster Archduke" Varas, brings her gifts and takes her on outings. She falls for him... but then discovers he thinks she's a witch and is searching for the real Selene! Can this actress convince her first love that she's really his wife? Or is she to be cast out of this role that's not rightfully hers?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: แกรนด์ดยุกแห่งแดนเหนือ

title.english: The Grand Duke of the North

182590.description:
Shuelina has only ever wanted to be loved as she grew up in an orphanage. But after her birth father rejected her in a previous life, she tries to find a family who will accept her in this one. Luckily, Archduke Bylot and his sons fall for her indomitable spirit, and they shower her with the love she has longed for. But once they find out she's the long-lost imperial princess, can she be a part of their family? Or will she have to go back to the people who sent her away in the first place?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Why Are You So Obsessed with Rejecting Love?
Why Do You Love Me When I Refuse Your Request?
ไม่อยากเป็นคนโปรดไง ทำไมยังตื๊ออยู่อีกคะ

182591.description:
Beauty, brains wealth—Duke Claude Winterville had it all, except one thing: sleep. Then April Renoen, a healer-barista, walks in and cures his insomnia with a single cup of her coffee. As they grow closer, Claude discovers that it's not just her coffee that captivates him, but the woman herself...

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: I Didn't Lull You to Sleep Only for You to Be Obsessed
I Didn’t Mean to Make Him Obsessed

182592.description:
How would you win over an enemy who just won't stop killing you? Laila thought she had escaped death by figuring out how to turn back time, but her assassin finds her again... and again... and again! All because her sadistic villain of a father had to murder his entire family... When all her evasion plans fail, there's only one option left: coddle her enemy through his childhood and hope he'll spare her when he comes back to exact his revenge. But why is this wacko so pigheaded?!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Even if the Villain's Daughter Regresses
As Regressões da Filha do Vilão

182593.description:
As a self-proclaimed expert on archdukes of the north, Krisha has one goal in life. To marry one. However, all her plans are immediately overturned when she finds out she's already married to the emperor. To make matters worse, he wants a divorce! If that happens, not only will she become a divorcee at age 21, but she'll be banished from the mainland for the next 10 years. Though she sets out to give the emperor a piece of her mind, little does she know he's not the only obstacle to her dream...

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I'm Not Even Married, What Divorce, Your Majesty?
How Can There Be a Divorce When We Haven't Even Married, Your Majesty?

Waking up in a novel is bad enough, but being the villainess Daphne Peregrine is even worse! Knowing the doomed character's fate, Daphne starts mending her strained relationship with her family, hoping they'll let her move to a peaceful land. Since she'll need money, Daphne asks the enigmatic Archduke Luciel Gresbel to go into the antidote-making business with her so she can use his noble connections. Despite realizing Kittia is a cat at first sniff, the Gritwolfs decide to take her in as the family’s youngest daughter. All she wants is a quiet and ordinary life, but instead she’s spoiled from all sides: doting parents, overprotective brothers, knights begging to guard her, a childhood prince promising an empire, and a charming demon declaring she’s his only desire. Surrounded by devotion, affection, and endless expectations, Evelia faces a choice: create her own path, or let the world decide her fate. Can the little peep finally take flight on her own terms?

(Source: WEBTOON)

After challenging the official story of a conglomerate chairman’s suspicious death backfires, investigative journalist Gu Won is demoted to the entertainment desk. Now relegated to chasing celebrity gossip, he is assigned to dig up dirt on the nation’s top actor, Han Ji-Hee. However, the hunter becomes the prey when a night of tailing ends in a blackout. Gu Won wakes up in the same bed as his target, met only with a cryptic promise of a reward once his memory finally returns.

Then, one day, Seong-Hyeon discovers a piece of clothing soaked in pheromones among the gifts he received from Jae-Yeon. Overcome by the pheromones, he experiences an unusual heat. 182606.description:
A young man suffering from a fatal and strange illness called 'Iramachin Disease' visits a certain female doctor who had been leading a frustrated and boring daily life. The only cure for his illness is to guide him to ejaculation using a woman's body. Can she save the young man...!? Introducing the debut work of the master 'Oral Meister' Dr. Miyoshi!

182607.description:
Drugs are the sweetest and most dangerous honey in the world.

Soka, a new investigator in the Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare's Narcotics Control Bureau, known as "Matri," which is in charge of controlling the daily increase in drug crimes, is worn out by the day and night work he has to do. Moreover, Takatori, a senior agent who works with him, is a peculiar character who is only interested in the amount of money seized...?

182610.description:
Yuu Kaneko has lived his whole life on a small, peaceful island, and he wants nothing more than to leave it behind for Tokyo and the big-city life. But one day, that peace is shattered when his fellow islanders are mysteriously infected and start to tear one another apart! Those afflicted regenerate at inhuman speeds, even growing back severed limbs, and nothing seems capable of stopping them. As the numbers swell, how are the few left unaffected going to survive…?

(Source: Yen Press)

182611.description: An anthology manga about the castles of Japan.

title.native: コミック 日本の名城

182612.description:
Mr. Futagawa bought a popular game and Miyako decides to challenge him to a match. To make things more interesting, they put a little wager on the results. The loser has to do whatever the winner says! Who will win and just what will they ask the other to do?

(Source: Irodori Comics)

182613.description:
Toushirou, an omega, and Alex, his Nyartigian alpha mate, are spending each day together in bliss-until Alex receives a summons to go to the UK for a temporary assignment. What’s more, the letter comes with an extra note: Bring your omega mate with you. Though Alex hesitates over the dangers of bringing an omega overseas, Toushirou is fascinated by the idea of visiting a foreign country. But the new land awaiting them might not be as welcoming as Toushirou hopes, and the two must give their all to protect their relationship against those who wish to tear it down…

(Source: Yen Press)

One day, the black smoke appeared without warning. And people began to change. With the food they had recently eaten. This strange phenomenon spread without giving humans a chance to respond, and the situation gradually became more chaotic... How will humanity overcome this situation?

182618.description:
Down-on-his-luck Si-Yun is prone to fainting and has a mountain of bills to pay. When he wins the “Vampire Lottery,” he gets matched with a vampire named Jin-U and becomes his blood donor. The two of them move in together, and although their relationship is strictly contractual, Si-Yun and Jin-U soon begin to fall in love. Things are finally looking up for Si-Yun--until his rare blood type starts drawing the attention of other vampires…

(Source: Tapas)

182619.description:
Lady Selina was betrayed by the crown prince, framed for a crime she didn’t commit, and executed by poison. That should have been the end of her story—until time rewound, handing her a second chance.

This time, she’s not holding back. After all, that “murder” she was accused of was just a little misunderstanding! Dropping a flowerpot on the saintess’s head isn’t exactly lethal. Reflecting on her downfall, Selina realizes she didn’t fail because of her schemes. She failed because she didn’t have loyal minions to execute them properly.

Determined to rewrite her fate, she takes in a group of orphans with nothing to lose and subjects them to grueling, cutthroat training. What emerges isn’t just a team of assassins—they’re the deadliest, most fanatically devoted elite the kingdom has ever seen. And they answer only to her.

Armed with her overpowered entourage and sharp wit, Selina is ready to crush anyone who stands in her way. Dive into a chaotic adventure where a morally flexible villainess embraces her second chance, seeking revenge and rewriting the rules of heroism.

This is the story of a heroine with a completely warped sense of morality in her second life—a slightly off-kilter reverse reincarnation tale of villainy and mistaken heroism!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

182620.description:
Takato and Azusa grew up as childhood friends, sharing a bond that went beyond mere friendship. However, after an unexpected event during their student days, they drifted apart and stopped communicating. Years later, Takato has become a popular model and actor, and he’s appointed as the exclusive model for the high-end brand where Azusa works. When they unexpectedly reunite, Azusa pretends to be a stranger, while Takato remains the same as he was in the past.
As Takato struggles to suppress his feelings for Azusa—who still remembers the warmth of their shared moments—he finds it increasingly difficult to hide his emotions.
“It should have been over.”
Yet there’s a reason they can’t simply become lovers...

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

It’s been a week since Ame Otosaka started high school. While glancing down the hallway, he catches sight of a familiar face: Umi Karasaki, a classmate from his middle school who had been absent without notice since the very first day of term.
Even when she finally makes it to school, Umi remains a mystery: always looking down, hiding behind a mask of polite, empty smiles. Concerned, Ame decides to reach out and speak to her...

182630.description:
​Shori Himesaki has always had recurring dreams of a medieval world where a valiant knight protects a beautiful princess. He's spent his life idly assuming that he must have been the knight in a past life.
​But that all changed at his high school entrance ceremony. The moment he lays eyes on Asako Kishi, the truth hits him: his past life wasn't the knight's at all.
​He was the princess... and she was the one sworn to protect him.

182645.description:
A former black company employee starts an unrivaled streaming and broadcasting life.

“Employment is, indeed, a life-ending endeavor…”
Sighing, Tanaka Makoto, a salaryman working for the Black Guild, faces another dungeon raid.

One day, he mistakenly sets up his work log stream, broadcasting his dungeon conquest to the entire nation.

"Tyrant Dragon defeated in one hit!?"
"A Sword Saint appears in the modern world!"

Tanaka's display of extraordinary abilities turns the stream into a festival!

“W-What?! 100 million concurrent viewers…?!”

Unexpectedly becoming an incredibly popular streamer, Tanaka quits his black company job to become an independent streamer—

182646.description:
Aiba Hashiru, summoned to another world as a hero, fought the Demon Lord to a standstill. When he came to, he was back in his own time, in modern Japan, still possessing the strength of the strongest hero. As planned before his summoning, Hashiru began working as a new teacher at a private girls' high school.

He thought he could finally lead a normal life—but then he encountered one of his students fighting a bizarre, otherworldly monster in the mountains…!? It further turned out that the school Hashiru has joined is secretly attended by girls who fight in a "hidden world"...!?

After saving a student, Hashiru becomes involved in various hidden incidents…but the power of the hero, once the strongest in another world, remains overwhelmingly powerful in modern Japan—!?
synonyms: The Hero Teacher Who Returned Is Unparalleled Also In Modern World: Even Though It's The Modern, My Students Are Fighting Monsters, Aliens, And Mysterious Organizations

182647.description:
The fantasy novel, The Sacred Hero Iris, was adapted into a game. One day, a man was reborn as Euglam, the Empire's strongest third prince and the final boss. To avoid his destined death at the hands of Iris, the enemy kingdom's princess and the game's protagonist, Euglam decided to seek asylum in her kingdom! And finally, he met Iris.

But the luxurious kingdom life he expected didn't begin. Instead, he spent his days teaching Iris swordsmanship, acting as her bodyguard, going on dates, and even becoming a father figure to a loli assassin!

With his innate Magic Core granting him absolute defense through Magical Barriers, he overwhelms those around him, but…!? "——Well, I'm the strongest, after all."

The lovey-dovey story of the final boss who has switched sides and the pure and lovely protagonist (with a violent streak?) begins!!
synonyms: What If the Strongest Final Boss of The Original Story Became The Protagonist's Companion?

title.native: 原作最強のラスボスが主人公の仲間になったら？
title.romaji: Gensaku Saikyou no Last Boss ga Shujinkou no Nakama ni Nattara?

182648.description:
They tried to silence her, but she doesn't need a voice to twist the odds in her favor. When Liliana wakes up in the body of an otome game villainess, she knows it's do or die. As the daughter of a duke and a candidate to marry the crown prince, she faces constant threats from assassins and her father's political enemies. Worse still, a fever has left her mute, unable to call for help or use magic to defend herself. Or so they all think! One quick attempt is all it takes for Liliana to shatter the common sense of her world, which dictates that incantations are mandatory for spellcasting. Now, all she needs to do is escape the grim destiny that awaits her. Though her foresight can only take her so far—the game doesn't start for another seven years—nothing can stop a six-year-old armed with erudition and cheat-level magic.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

182649.description: Sakurai, who has always been a "shadowy person'' since childhood, decided to break away from that self when he got a job. He was supposed to make his debut as a "positive person'' based on information he had heard on the Internet, but on his first day at the company, he suddenly committed a crime against Toba, who was rumored to be a "demon boss.'' Coupled with self-loathing, Sakurai cries in front of Toba when he runs into her in the bathroom, but something seems strange about Toba? Misunderstanding between a demon boss and a fake positive rookie ∞ A romantic comedy

182651.description:
"Adventurer registration canceled? I don't mind. I was thinking about retiring anyway."

Reito Harukaze, who had climbed to the highest adventurer rank, has his adventurer license revoked by the guild that manages dungeons. The cancellation of Reito’s registration, an SSS-ranked adventurer, causes chaos within the guild. However, as he had already been considering retirement, Reito remains unfazed and uses this opportunity to retire and live a slow, quiet life.

"Hey, big brother, buy me a meal!"

One day, at the park, he meets Karen, an incredibly beautiful girl who is struggling with money. Hearing her situation, Reito decides to give her a simple lecture to help her conquer a dungeon.

"Thanks to you, I was able to clear my first dungeon! Master!"
"Let’s not use 'Master' outside the dungeon, okay..."

As they venture into dungeons together, Karen grows attached to Reito and starts admiring him as her mentor, unaware that he’s actually an SSS-ranked adventurer. Gradually, she begins to fall for him.

"Could it be that Master is actually really strong...?"

Reito was supposed to be enjoying a peaceful, slow life in retirement, but instead, he finds himself adored by a rookie adventurer girl—what will happen next?

Thus begins the unintentional, overwhelming fantasy of a former strongest adventurer starting from his retirement!
synonyms: An Unexpectedly Relaxing Slow Life After Being Dismissed? I Was Supposed to Retire, But Somehow Ended Up Becoming The Mentor of a Beautiful Gyaru, and For Some Reason, She Got Super Attached to Me

182653.description:
Gu Xueyi was born into a military family who became the matron of the prosperous Sheng clan, overseeing more than 400 family members. But when she woke up one day, she found herself transmigrated into a novel as the wife of the male lead, who was about to divorce her and doomed to die young. Seeing her husband Yan Chao's crooked siblings made Gu Xueyi seethe. She didn't care whether her husband wanted to divorce or not. The most important thing was to make something out of these useless family members!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Betrayed by her fiancé, Bai Pu seduces her fiancé’s uncle Lu Zhaohe and sleeps with him to get revenge. But what was meant to be a game of revenge slowly develops into true love…

(Source: WebComics, edited)

182655.description:
A top-level player accidentally transmigrates into the game character "he" was playing, a max-level priestess. She will team up with a dragon-maid to venture into this brand new world! However — why do all these girls keep looking at her in this funny way?!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

182656.description:
Izawa, an ordinary junior high school teacher, meets Tao, an innocent looking girl, at a brothel in Phnom Penh, the capital of Cambodia. He gives her a large sum of money to help her sick mother before returning home. However, when Izawa visits Phnom Penh again in search of the girl, he is accused of fraud and ends up being imprisoned for a crime he didn't commit! Izawa's lonely fight for freedom is just beginning…

(Source: MangaHot, translated)

title.romaji: P. I. P. : Prisoner in Phnom Penh

182657.description:
One day on the train to work, Mayama, a company employee, found his hand pushed against the chest of a young man dressed as a woman, against his will. The next day, he was coerced into a game of "molesting" with a photo taken the day before used as leverage. Tsukasa, a college student, can only feel aroused on the train due to his past trauma. Each morning, they meet in the same spot, their bodies pressed closely together until they reach their stop. As their encounters continue, they must navigate the complexities of their situation and the unexpected bond that begins to form between them.

"I have to push him away, but when he touched me, his eyes trembled with sadness, and I couldn't resist..."

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

182658.description:
Machi works in a brothel to pay off his father's debt, resenting his circumstances and taking out his frustration on those around him. Despite this, Masakazu, a co-worker, treats him with kindness and looks after him. As Machi gradually opens his heart to Masakazu, he finds himself developing feelings for him. However, he soon realizes that he is entangled in Masakazu's distorted view of love...

(Source: Fusion Product, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

182659.description: The comic adaptation of the TV anime "Suicide Squad" has finally arrived! Gotham City, a city of crime. Amanda Waller, the head of ARGUS, has summoned a group of vicious prisoners for a certain mission. Harley Quinn, Deadshot, Peacemaker, Clayface, and King Shark. The Gotham villains were sent to a world of swords and magic connected by a gate, "ISEKAI", where orcs roam and dragons fly in the sky! They have bombs on their necks! They die instantly if they run away! They die instantly if they fail the mission! Can Harley and the others survive this ISEKAI, with their life-threatening mission on their backs? The dramatic and violent tale of the Suicide Squad, a special force unit that is determined to die, begins! (Source: JumpToon, translated)

182669.description:
“I've been waiting for you for so long. Come quickly. Destroy me...”

Cracks started to form within Aoba's ordinary life on a remote southwestern island off the coast of Japan as he gets caught up in a dangerous game! The game, Rhyme, is an ultra-realistic online game that has recently been growing in popularity with the young adults living in Midorijima. Despite being uninterested in the game, Aoba finds himself dragged into a match against his will with an unknown opponent. As Aoba fights desperately with his artificial lifeform buddy, Ren, a voice calls out to wake him up. Soon, Aoba finds himself trying to unravel the conspiracy lying at the heart of Midorijima with the help of some unsavory men and his special ability.

(Source: Comikey)

Note: This entry is for the manga series that was originally released in webtoon format on Jamtoon, not to be mistaken for the version that was serialized in a magazine.

182670.description:
Once the fallen priest, Salvator, who was trying to win prize money by joining a group of adventurers, realized the group had no hope, he offered to become Patricia’s “dog”. But surprisingly, her dominant tendencies suited him well, and his satisfaction only increased by the day…

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
synonyms: Can I be a Sex Slave, Not a Priest?
Can't I Have A Prostitute Instead Of A Cleric?

A special collection of new stories, art, and more after the finale of the bestselling Mushoku Tensei light novels that inspired the hit anime!

The epic journey has reached its conclusion, but plenty of stories are left to tell for the Jobless Reincarnation cast! Return to the Six-Faced World with this special collection of new adventures while catching up with your favorite characters.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

182672.description:
In this world, there are two special categories of people known as "forks" and "cakes." Forks—the predators, normal humans who lack a sense of taste. Cakes—the prey, the one thing forks find irresistibly delicious, often luring them to commit heinous crimes. High school hottie Tatsunari has spent his whole life hiding the fact that he's a fork, but all that changes when he accidentally gets a taste of a cute, glasses-wearing junior. The explosion of sweetness has him falling head over heels for the flavor...and for the boy himself!

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: Love from the Tip of the Tongue

title.english: Love from the Tip of the Tongue

My first morning and my first Christmas after turning 40.

A special one-shot that takes place the day after the final chapter.

(Source: Libre, translated)

182674.description:
Hanabishi Teppei, a Yakuza group leader, has teamed up with Lan, a Hong Kong mafioso, and is sharpening his fangs in the underworld—but secretly, the two are lovebirds! One day, when one of his subordinates is taken hostage and he has no money to pay the ransom, the Hanabishi Group decides to raise funds through porn streaming! Behind Lan's back, Teppei starts streaming erotic videos of himself, but soon realizes that juggling the Yakuza lifestyle with streaming, doujinshi, and even infiltrating brothels is far more complicated than he anticipated. What exactly is the real work of this soft, fluffy Yakuza?!

(Source: Libre, translated)

182676.description:
The "Clan of the Sacrifice" is bound by fate, destined to be eaten by demons if caught before the age of 20. After the death of his grandmother, college student Itaru discovers for the first time that he is a descendant of this clan. Just before his 20th birthday, his true identity is revealed to Hayate, the leader of the demon clan. In a shocking turn of events, Hayate suddenly kisses Itaru, leaving him momentarily frozen. "It’s different from the old days," Hayate whispers, "now we don’t eat you; we take your spiritual power through sex." As Itaru grapples with this revelation and is subdued by Hayate’s demonic power, he finds himself having his sperm drawn out by Hayate...!?

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

182677.description:
"My smile is specially reserved for you." Kotori Ogata, self-conscious about her plump figure, is inexplicably adored by Soma, a younger coworker known for his frosty demeanor. The reason likely traces back to a rainy day encounter: Kotori finds Soma shivering at a bus stop and, being a meddlesome caretaker, helps him warm up. Since then, Soma has been incredibly affectionate toward Kotori. He defends her from sarcastic comments from her manager, holds her hand claiming he's cold, and even sweetly tells her, "Everything you do is adorable to me." Step into this romance and experience the cute moments between warm-hearted Kotori and her frosty younger coworker, Soma!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

182679.description:
Shurine is a girl who has mastered the sword, having been raised to serve as a bodyguard. However, she is falsely accused of assassinating the person she is guarding and forced to goes on the run. Driven from her home, Shurine meets Lutecia, a duke's daughter whose life is in danger after being caught up in a battle over royal succession.

As Lutecia is being attacked by an assassin, Shurine makes her an offer, "I'm a bit short on money. If you need a bodyguard, I'm available right now."

Their encounter will determine the fate of the kingdom! A girls-love swordplay battle fantasy begins!

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

182680.description:
Adopted by the powerful Macgovern family after the death of his entire tribe, Karyl becomes the empire's greatest swordmaster who leads his men to victory in the Oracle War. But on the final battlefield, Emperor Olivurn betrays him and dooms the nation. Determined to find the cause of this treachery, Karyl travels back in time and commits himself to learning skills he never had in order to uncover the truth. Will he succeed? Or will Olivurn's trickery outsmart him again?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: 9クラスのソードマスター〜剣の求道者〜

title.english: The 9th Class Swordmaster: Blade of Truth

182681.description:
Halo, the greatest musician of his time, gets into a car accident on his way to the Grammy Awards. When he comes to, he finds himself in the body of a young Korean boy named Noh Hae-Il. He is left in a place where the surroundings and the times are different. After confirming that Noh Hae-Il's English name is Halo, he feels a strong sense of destiny. Halo enters Hae-Il. He demonstrates his genius even in this era.

(Source: Naver, translated)

182685.description:
When brawler Kang Ji-Hwan is forced to transfer schools, the last thing he expects is to rely on the top student in class. But after accidentally tearing model-student Han Yu-Seong’s uniform, and discovering the fierce tiger tattoo hidden on his back, Ji-Hwan offers a deal: he’ll keep Yu-Seong’s secret if Yu-Seong becomes his tutor. To push Ji-Hwan away, Yu-Seong turns up the heat with bold, intimate teasing… but the closer he gets, the more Ji-Hwan finds himself drawn in. Between hidden claws and rising tension, two boys with tiger hearts may be getting far too close for comfort.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Season 2 is rated R19.
