Roy and Billy, both members of the New York State Police, are rivals. The day after a drinking contest, they wake up to find themselves on TV declaring, “We’re getting married!” Billy tries to act normally, but an argument about work leads to Roy kissing him unexpectedly.

182690.description:
Ritsuro Shiromiya, a well-known counselor and commentator, has lived his life hiding that he is a Sub. However, his suppressants are no longer effective, and his condition worsens as he struggles to suppress his instincts. Then a former childhood friend, Yukuru Takahina, visits him at work. Yukuru was the first Dom who has ever “ordered” Ritsuro to do something. What is the “partnership contract” between two people navigating the delicate balance between those who want to dominate and those who want to be dominated?

Tsukasa, a game character designer, is a long-time fan of Kirari Koi, a popular virtual streamer. One night, after a few too many drinks, Tsukasa accidentally breaks into someone else's room and encounters the resident, Ren. When he hears Ren's voice—a perfect mimic of Kirari Koi—Tsukasa is taken aback and accused of being a stalker fan for recognizing it. In a flustered attempt to explain himself, Tsukasa reveals his identity and says he’ll “do anything” to be forgiven. To his surprise, Ren responds, “Then become my lover...”

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

182693.description:
Chika Ugotsuki lives the life of a yakuza. Following orders from his superiors, he finds himself staying at a cursed property. Gifted with the ability to "see," Chika soon encounters a series of supernatural phenomena. As he begins to feel his life is in danger, he is confronted by an underground idol named Suzume Kokuryu. To his surprise, Kokuryu challenges him to battle the oncoming supernatural events using an unexpected act, sex!

(Source: Fusion Product, translated)

Note: Includes the one-shot "Love Hater (ラブへイター)" and one extra chapter.

182694.description:
Mysterious cone-shaped objects are falling from the sky. Those who are locked-on to it cannot move from their spot and can only wait for the cone to pierce their brain as it slowly approaches...

This collection of stories includes a variety of horror stories, including the masterpiece short story `Tenzui', and includes bizarre, violent and vengeful stories, where seven schoolgirls are thrown into the depths of fear.

It will make your hair stand up, make you cry, warm your heart, make you tremble, and make you despair...

Enjoy this new horror experience filled with a complex mix of emotions.

Jimmy is a gang member in one of the world's few underground cities, Silent Bay City. One day, he meets a girl and gets embroiled in a fight between the creatures of the night. Brought to you by the author of "Levius", Haruhisa Nakata, Night Light Hounds is a thrilling dark fantasy!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

182697.description:
"I want to be by her side until the very last moment..."

In the autumn of her twentieth year, Rachel marries her childhood friend Noah, her long-time crush. Even though she knows that the person Noah truly loved is his sister and Rachel's best friend, Alicia... Bright and beautiful Alicia was born with a heart condition, and her remaining time is limited. Rachel's marriage with Noah is built on on a lie, just to allow them to stay close to Alicia in what little time she had left. Rachel has moments of incredible happiness, but also feels guilt and heartache at the same time. However, before she knew it, she begins to notice Noah's passionate gaze looking her way… Who is the real "bystander" in this love triangle?

The long-awaited manga adaptation of a heart-wrenching story of unrequited love, irreplaceable friendship, and mutual misunderstandings!

(Source: J-Publishing, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

182700.description:
This feeling is neither friendship nor atonement. It is unmistakably love.

Rachel asks Noah to marry her in a fake marriage in order to be near her ailing best friend, Alicia. More importantly, she wanted to stay with Noah, Alicia's brother and Rachel's long-time crush. She knows that Noah secretly has feelings for his sister. Their life together will be full of friendship, lies, and guilt. Their contract marriage will bring moments of dazzling happiness and a heartache that will never go away....... But gradually, Noah's casually affectionate words and attitude cause Rachel's heart to race.......

"You're my wife. No matter if it's temporary or whatever, you're the most important person in my life."

But she lies out of guilt and they drift apart. What will become of the relationship between the two, whose love grows beyond their ability to resist?

(Source: Fairy Kiss, translated)

The gluttonous monster Yattara is summoned in a city of opulence and decadence. This harbinger of destruction has a vast appetite that cannot be satisfied until entire nations are leveled. As it comes across three gauntly malnourished children in a garbage-piled, foul-smelling room, it opens its maw as usual…but realizes that even the beast of gluttony prefers a delectable meal. And if Yattara was going to eat them anyway, it might as well prepare its meal properly to relish a flavor never experienced. After all, Yattara has never once let a meal slip away, and it’s in no hurry…

A lowly gate guard, just another nameless soldier—but secretly, he was the strongest soldier!?

One day, Silva realizes he's been reborn as a mob soldier in the very game he was obsessed with in his previous life. To survive in this dangerous world, he uses his game knowledge to become incredibly strong, but hides his true power to avoid altering the game's storyline. However, by chance, he easily cuts down a powerful demon that even the hero struggles against. And, what's more, he does so right in front of his favorite heroine…! From that moment, word of his strength gradually begins to spread—!?

A heroic fantasy where the strongest mob soldier unleashes his full potential for the sake of his favorite character!

182721.description:
Suddenly, the war against the "Outsiders", also known as the "IW Calamity", that appeared on Earth ended with humanity's victory. Peace returned to the world. During the recovery efforts, I, Momozawa Motoo, am chosen as a close aide to a certain someone: the former savior who led humanity to victory with her ability to foresee the future, called 'Future Sight'—Kamitarai Mio.

Upon our first meeting, she suddenly declares, "It seems we're getting married in the future, you know?"

Thus my daily life with her begins. At school, we hide our true identities and act as lovers; after school, we live together as neighbors. In this lively and enjoyable daily life, I gradually come to know Mio as a person... This is an ordinary love story with a former savior, set in a world that has finally found peace.

182727.description:
Falsely accused of attempting to assassinate her fiancé, the Crown Prince, Countess Leticia and her entire family were executed. She was then reborn in Japan, retaining the memories of her past ambition to become a mage-engineer, and achieved success as an engineer — but then she died in a traffic accident. And now… she's been sent back to her 12-year-old self, before the engagement!? There's no way she'll repeat the same mistakes. An engagement? Absolutely not! She'll use her skills to develop new magical artifacts to uncover the conspiracy and save her family!

(Source: Hifumishobo, translated)

When a mysterious disease with no known cause or cure appeared, the patients must be euthanized as they can cause tremendous damage to the surrounding area if left alone. Two agents from the disaster response team have completely opposite ideas about how to best deal with this disease, and their conflict causes trouble...!?

(Source: Shounen Jump Plus, translated)

182729.description:
In front of a weepy high school student, Ami, the girl he has feelings for, suddenly starts crying. It turns out she was harshly rejected by Tatara, a senior feared by everyone around him. Furious, Ami confronts Tatara to demand an apology, but he is shaken by Tatara's presence and ends up confronting him in tears. The next day, Tatara summons Ami and unexpectedly tells him to "cry," leaving him confused. Tatara, who claims that crying faces are his fetish, reveals he is most aroused by Ami's tearful expression and threatens to make him cry for his own amusement!

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

182730.description:
"Let me hear more of your moans." "Ngh...! That's so intense... I'll come instantly...!" He continuously shoots through her messy, innermost place. Himeno's a serious university student with a stable life. One day, Kenyuu, a young boss from the yakuza, suddenly shows up in her life and falls in love with her at first sight. She's scared of him at first, but his pushy approach makes her unable to forget his warmth... He makes her come intensely, both with his fingers and with his tongue, making her wonder what's going to happen to her!! The sex with a smitten member of the yakuza is amazing! Read the love story about two people with a different social status!

(Source: Coolmic)

182731.description:
In a nation where magic reigns supreme, the only duke's daughter, Eltriede, who cannot use magic, was supposed to have been executed for her cruel and heinous deeds, having exploited wealth and power to the fullest.

However, she finds herself back on her eighth birthday, ten years in the past!?

Regretting her past life, Eltriede chooses to live outside of noble society. Instead of her own country, where technology has stagnated due to an over-reliance on magic, she acquires advanced knowledge and skills from other nations, becoming a highly intelligent and capable woman.

Although she wishes to live peacefully, far from the aristocracy, Eltriede is practically forced to participate in the selection process for the Crown Prince's consort!?

Resolved to bring happiness to those wronged by her schemes in her previous life, now that she's inevitably involved with noble society, Eltriede begins to devise clever plans and take action―!

A reverse reincarnation fantasy where a lady who returned from death uses her past life's experiences and the vast knowledge she acquired in this life to bring happiness to others!
synonyms: The Villainess Who Returned From Death Will Make Everyone Happy In Her Second Life

title.native: 死に戻りの悪役令嬢は、二度目の人生ですべてを幸せにしてみせる
title.romaji: Shi ni Modori no Akuyaku Reijou wa, Nidome no Jinsei de Subete wo Shiawase ni Shite Miseru

182732.description:
The self-centered marchioness, Rosa Kreutzers, is injured after being kicked by a horse on the way home from the theater with Prince Alex. But in that moment, Rosa realizes something significant:

"This is the world from the manga I read in my past life! And I'm a minor villainous character destined to be poisoned!"

In her previous life, she was an overworked corporate slave who died from exhaustion. In this life, she's a villainess slated for poisoning. There's no way she's letting that happen—not when she's been reborn into unimaginable wealth! She'll spend freely and live a long and luxurious life! This is Rosa's struggle to avoid her predetermined fate and enjoy a life of extravagant luxury.

title.native: 王子様などいりません！　～脇役の金持ち悪女に転生していたので、今世では贅沢三昧に過ごします～
title.romaji: Ouji-sama nado Irimasen! Wakiyaku no Kanemochi Akujo ni Tensei Shiteita node, Konse de wa Zeitaku Zanmai ni Sugoshimasu

182733.description:
In a forgotten corner of a massive castle, a starving child teeters on the edge of and death...until she suddenly awakens with the memories of Chihiro Sagami, an office worker from modern Japan?! Determined to survive at all costs, she stumbles upon a kindhearted chef and strikes a deal: food in exchange for work. Though small in stature, her nimble hands and capable skills quickly earn her the fond nickname "Little Helper" among the castle staff. But behind her infectious eagerness and penchant for delicious food, her mysterious golden eyes hold a great secret that could determine the fate of the world!

(Source: Manga UP!)
synonyms: Anata no Ojou no Kobito-san: Gohan Kudasai, Hatarakimasu

182736.description:
Two years have passed since another world and reality suddenly merged. Nanashiro, a high school student burdened by debt and forced to work constantly, helps her classmate, Yuuhime Kurenai, with her streaming activities in that other world at Kurenai's request. To his surprise, Yuuhime’s true identity is none other than his favorite VTuber, Kirurun!

While filming Kurenai's battles and adventures, he makes her dishes using ingredients from the other world. Surprisingly, his abilities, which should remain unchanged, start to grow! What's more, he even begins to tame previously unknown creatures—!?

The adventure of a favorite VTuber and her strongest butler begins, as he uses his honed skills to nurture for and guide unfortunate girls!

182739.description:
A handsome boy on the verge of puberty vs. an overly-competent butler, in a slapstick comedy!

One day, a man came to “Finn,” a young boy who lives in a big mansion, to apply for the job of butler. In no time at all, the new butler, “Al” becomes a valuable member of the household, recognized for his perfect work ethic. However, Finn is not happy about how Al always treats him like a child. So he tries to play pranks on the nagging butler just for fun and to get back at him.

(Source: Comic Porta, translated)

182740.description:
Betrayed by his best friend, our protagonist loses everything: billions in wealth, his loved ones, and even his legs. In “Online Game: I Can Evolve Everything,” he gets a second chance at life. Reborn with a burning desire for vengeance, he vows to reclaim everything that was taken from him.

When a revolutionary online game arrives, he finds himself at an advantage. No one understands this game better than he does! By getting into the game early and spending heavily, he can acquire a god-level skill known as "Evolve Everything." Now he prepares to exact his revenge. With his unmatched knowledge and newfound powers, he embarks on a journey to dominate the game and take back his rightful place in the world.

182742.description:

Assistant: "Sir, Madam's hospital was smashed."
"How's Madam?"
"Madam almost... beat him to death."
"Send the doctor to see if Madam hurt her hand!"

Rivals from all over the world: "Sweetheart, what's so great about that stodgy old man! Come with me, and the world is yours."

Rivals: "Well, that's just unfair."

One day, Naoya, the strongest high school delinquent in Kanto, missteps on the stairs of a pedestrian bridge and collides with Kana, the girl who was standing in front of him. Somehow, Kana's soul enters the body of Naoya, a fierce delinquent, while Naoya's soul enters the body of Kana, a plain-looking girl!

Naoya was hoping to enjoy the feeling a girl's body, but when he finally takes off her clothes, he finds that Kana's body is covered with wounds and scars, and it bothers him so much that he couldn't do anything. When Naoya goes to school as Kana, he is violently attacked in the bathroom by bullies targeting Kana. Naoya explodes with rage at Kana's bullies, who have no idea that there is now the spirit of a fierce fighter inside…!?

From late-night lovers’ quarrels and fake reports of lost items to life counseling for adults...these "guardians of local justice" confront the trivial human dramas that don't quite qualify as "cases," sometimes finding themselves influenced or swept up in the chaos. Yet, the "true feelings" they harbor haven't vanished. A police box drama that offers a glimpse behind the scenes of justice.

182766.description:
The relationship between detective and assistant is "love"!

Gokusukeku is tired of getting taken advantage of, due to his natural disposition to help others, so his new goal in life is to “be in charge” of any situation. However, when he transferred to a new high school, he reunites with three girls who worked together as detectives back in elementary school! Sukeku's heated battle for the position of being the detective (in charge) begins! However...the girls have feelings for him in a different way…!

(Source: Magapoke, translated)

182767.description:
Laguna, heir to a frontier noble house on the borderlands, is a reincarnated Japanese individual who discovers this world is actually the otome game he knew. Although he wants to live a leisurely life, he finds himself struggling with the unfamiliar task of managing a territory.

Suddenly, a marriage is arranged between Laguna and a member of a much higher-ranking noble family. The bride, Alicia, turns out to be the "villainess" from the otome game—

Laguna comes to realize that Alicia's designation as a "villain" is completely unfounded. As their bond deepens, however, Alicia becomes the target of an assassination attempt.

Can Laguna fend off the approaching danger and save Alicia from her predetermined fate (scenario)?
synonyms: The Villainess Who Married Into a Frontier Mob Noble Family Is Surprisingly a Wonderful Wife?

182768.description:
In a land of spirits, it is an unbearable shame to be born without one. Cast out from his noble birthplace, the spiritless Akira is forced to find a new life as a commoner, eking out a living by fighting the wild beasts that venture near the human lands—a far cry from the greatness he was supposedly destined for.

However, Akira's strange nature soon comes to light. His skill in amulet crafting and unprecedented resilience to miasma hint at the potential he conceals—potential soon to be tested when a slumbering god awakens to his presence.

The fire god of the south does not awaken alone, for no sooner does Akira receive her blessings than an ancient evil rises, threatening to devour his new home.

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: The God Slumbers In Fleeting Bubbles: The Expelled Boy Takes The Sword of The Fire God

182769.description:
Video game character Vice Hamilton is destined to lose everything—his position, his family, and ultimately his life. A tragic villain who was overshadowed by his talented sister, blamed for mismanaging his territory, and fated to fall at the hands of the game’s hero, Vice is nothing more than a failure. And to be reincarnated as him? A fate worse than death! Or is it?

Armed with knowledge of the game’s plot, the new Vice has a second chance to rewrite his fate and become a proper villain with a better future. Using his own cheats to avoid every pitfall, Vice has the ability to avoid doom and impending tragedy, all while winning the hearts of the beautiful ladies around him. Can he maintain this new course, grow his harem, and survive the plot that’s written against him?!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: I Like Villains, So I Reincarnated as One: Since I Was Reborn as My Favorite Character, Who Was Killed by The Protagonist Early In The Game, I Used My Exclusive Game Knowledge to Crush The Doom Flags And Ended Up Becoming The Emperor of Villains

Ruchika, a new student at Ojousama Gakuin, has been trying to get closer to Midori Sotama, ever since Midori became her assigned mentor. One day, Ruchika was worrying about not having a chance to talk with Midori, when she overhears Midori talking about wanting more “alone time”...

182780.description:
After a heart-stopping encounter with an unearthly apparition, a young woman becomes fixated on the spirits that linger in the shadows. Drawn into a chilling journey to confront the very essence of fear, she steps into a world where the boundary between the living and the dead fades into oblivion. As the heroine delves deeper into the occult, her quest to understand the afterlife soon reveals that terror doesn’t always come from the unknown—it hides in the places we think we know best. The ghosts she seeks might just be the ones chasing her.

In this supernatural thriller, prepare to face your deepest fears, as the lines between life and death, safety and danger, vanish into the darkness. Will she survive the haunting force she’s invited into her life? Or will she become one with the ghosts of Kanata?

(Source: Titan Manga)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

182781.description:
Kiminaga Orimi is a struggling student who has been caught working part-time in violation of school rules. In order to avoid expulsion from the school, he is assigned to do housework at the Chancellor's house... The Yoshijoji family is home to four beautiful sisters, each with her special talent! The eldest, Kikuri, is an artist and VTuber. The second girl, Ranka, is a popular live-streamer. The third sister, Umeru, is a professional gamer. The fourth, Takenana, is a genius voice actress. But despite their talents, the sisters are lazy in their daily lives, eating takeout, walking around in their underwear, and falling asleep in Orimi's bed!? Orimi is troubled by the sisters' “real faces” at first, until he gains their trust with his skilled housework. But then he receives a secret message…

“You will choose me again, won't you?"

Under one roof, daily life with the four sisters is about to unfold!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

182782.description:
Alec, the strongest mage, has become so powerful that he finds the peaceful world he created as a hero incredibly boring.

Believing he might encounter a worthy rival in the future, Alec decides to sleep for three hundred years… but…

When he awakens, Alec finds himself enrolled in what's called the "Bride Academy"—an institution dedicated to cultivating suitable partners for him.

Confused by this unexpected turn of events, Alec nonetheless recognizes the genuine strength of the "Princesses," the next generation of female mages attending the academy.

In response, Alex declares that he will also attend the academy—!?

A unique harem fantasy begins within this magical academy where every student is a potential bride, a story of an unparalleled hero who is completely unfamiliar with love.
synonyms: The Bride Academy Dedicated to The Last Hero: A Time-Traveling Mage Forges Bonds With The Next Generation of Princesses And Builds a Harem

182783.description:
“Kei’s gaming livestream! I really, really love it!”

Yukina Nozomi, a member of a nationally-known top idol group and my oshi, unexpectedly revealed that I am her oshi!?

Because of Yukina’s confession on her live stream, my game streaming channel, which previously had only single-digit subscribers, went viral!

Moreover, when Yuki discovers that I’m her classmate, she sheds her usual cool demeanor completely!?

“It's amazing to have the real Kei-kun right in front of me…!”

But it doesn't end there! A hugely popular VTuber (who also happens to be my childhood friend) and a legendary cosplayer who was on hiatus (and is my younger sister) start publicly declaring their feelings for me…. A reverse-oshi romantic comedy!
synonyms: Will You Become My Oshi, Now That I've Confessed My Feelings For You?

182785.description:
Alvin, possessing top-tier abilities, wants nothing more than an easy life, so he's been pretending to be incompetent. However, his doting older sister (who even proposed marriage to him!) accidentally witnesses his true power!

"I knew it! I believed in you, little brother! I have to go tell everyone right away!"

The rumor spreads like wildfire, and Alvin's treatment at the academy completely changes! He instantly defeats students who dare to challenge him, is recognized as the strongest mage by the princess (who also happens to be the knight commander), unexpectedly rises through the ranks of the knight order, and somehow finds himself surrounded by more and more girls—where did all the peace and quiet go!?

"You're so cool! I think I’m falling even more in love with you, little brother!"

...Meanwhile, completely oblivious to Alvin's anxieties, his sister gives him a huge hug.

182786.description:
Senei Academy, the sole institution capable of granting extraordinary abilities. Amamori Yuuto, for reasons of his own, desires an inconspicuous academy life. His ability, 'Weakened Eyesight', is so weak it inadvertently sparks the protective instincts of Kasumi Asahina, a beautiful classmate aspiring to be a hero.

As a result, Asahina becomes intensely attached to Yuuto, declaring, "I'll protect you!"

This close relationship makes Yuuto a target for the school bullies. However, Yuuto is deliberately concealing his true strength; he's actually a uniquely powerful individual possessing extraordinary abilities since before even entering the academy.

Secretly working to remove any obstacles, Yuuto devises a scheme, drawing Asahina into his machinations…

The story of a hidden powerhouse masquerading as an incompetent student, manipulating the academy from the shadows, begins!

Childhood friends Jun and Azusa get drenched in a sudden downpour on the way home from school.

The two of them rush to take shelter in Jun's house, where they each take a shower and change clothes with just the two of them there. In that situation, Jun notices Azusa's erotic charm as a woman upon seeing her lightly dressed in his old casual clothes, and he unknowingly gets erect?!

Kouichi Arima-sensei presents a tomboyish childhood friend who's soaking wet from the rain♪

182788.description:
After being engaged and then having her engagement broken, Sarana Kinje was supposed to enjoy a leisurely life with her family in the countryside. However, for some reason, she finds herself using her knowledge from her previous life to embark on a crafting and business journey!

Sarana Kinjie, a noblewoman who had her engagement broken by the second prince of the Kingdom of Golda, is actually a reincarnation of a woman in her forties who worked as an office lady in her previous life. Tired of the rigid treatment from the royal family and the formal noble society, the Kinje family decides to relocate to the home of Sarana's mother in a neighboring country.

Thus, Sarana was supposed to live a slow, peaceful life in the countryside with her parents, grandfather, and uncle's family. However, she begins to unexpectedly reshape her life by using her previous knowledge to start crafting. The products she creates become immensely popular, leading her to a life full of surprises!

What began as a way to pass the time—creating magical stone devices, cosmetics, comfortable bedding, dishes featuring magical creatures, and stable sources of income for the citizens—results in the guild leader becoming exhausted, her saving an orphanage, and being pursued by the younger brother of the king. This is Sarana Kinje, and I say hello!

The Sword Saint and the Grand Sage’s true identity is a failing student at the academy!? A new clandestine fantasy begins!

The apathetic Roy Luvel, a minor noble on the outskirts of a small country, is known as a poor student at the academy, earning the nickname “The Failing Noble.” However, he harbors a certain secret.

"The Guardian of the Sword Nation, the White Sword Saint, Cloud"
"The Guardian of the Magic Empire, the Black Grand Sage, Eclipse"

The true identities of the most praised individuals in these two great nations are none other than Roy, who pretends to be incompetent!

To protect his family, Roy hides his identity and leads a triple life, secretly working in each country and enjoying freedom at the academy. Moreover, he catches the interest of beautiful girls at the academy who aspire to become Sword Saint and Grand Sage… Roy’s extraordinary daily life and battles are fiercely intense!

“I’d love to quit being a guardian, but until a successor appears, I guess I’ll keep protecting the world.”

The new clandestine fantasy of the ultimate noble who has mastered both sword and magic begins here!!

Everyone knows Kang Su-hyun. The Class president, social butterfly, the kind of guy who shines in every corner of campus life. But even the brightest star has shadows.His secret? It’s his hidden world, one that absolutely no one can ever discover.At least, that was the plan.One day, his double life is accidentally exposed to the very last person he’d want: Lim Ji-ah, the school outcast who barely talks to anyone.“Wait… sunbae, you’re that famous lewd artist? Hehe… guess I’ve got some leverage now, huh?”From that moment on, Su-hyun’s carefully maintained image as Mr. Perfect begins to crumble.Stuck between bribes, blackmail, and the most awkward partnership imaginable, can a campus golden boy survive having his NSFW alter ego in the hands of an unlikely accomplice?

182801.description:
Kim Gitae looks like your typical college student—aside from his killer looks and strangely eerie vibe. But there's one thing that sets him apart: he can see ghosts. Spirits swarm him day and night, desperate to possess his body, and the only way he can fend them off... is by jerking off every night. Yeah, it’s as exhausting as it sounds. All Gitae wants is a normal life—but things take a wild turn when a naked ghost named Lee Serin suddenly appears with an offer he can’t ignore. If he agrees to sleep with her, she’ll use her powers to protect him from other spirits. A ghostly hookup for a shot at peace—what could possibly go wrong? Gitae’s not-so-average college life just got a whole lot weirder.

The secret behind the ever-evolving “Love Chair Lab” lies in the dedication of its employees, who throw themselves into their work with full devotion!

What started as an immersive gaming experience for her day off quickly turns into a nightmare when she realizes she’s stuck inside. Now, surrounded by irresistibly handsome men and intense encounters, she desperately wants to escape. But there’s one problem: the game doesn’t plan on letting her leave anytime soon!

182809.description:
Noboru Hirata, a white-collar salesman, spends his days working under the eye of Misaki Takamiya, the president's secretary who’s admired from afar by co-workers both male and female. One day, Noboru's co-worker plays a prank on him and downloads a gay hookup app onto his phone. Out of curiosity, he decides to give the app a shot, and to his great surprise, finds a profile with photos that eerily match those of his internet crush, “Misaki.” With surprise and anticipation, Noboru starts to wonder… What if his beloved “Misaki” is a man? Noboru matched with Misaki. The conversation was lively and the distance between the two grew closer, and they finally decided to meet at a hotel. However it turns out the person who came to the hotel is, Misaki Takamiya, his workplace’s Madonna!?

182810.description:
Taka is a strikingly handsome young man who works as a host to earn money, which he then spends tipping the camboy he subscribes to, a straight man named Ren. To Taka, Ren is a far more beautiful flower than any of the women who lavish money on him. Ren's sparkling nipple piercings, his special reverse bunny costume livestreams, and more are all made possible by Taka, a longtime viewer, and the money he has donated. One day, out of the blue, the object of his adoration sends him a message: "I want to meet you." Unsettled but intrigued, Taka decides this is an opportunity he cannot pass up and agrees to meet Ren in person. The two soon fall into a physical relationship, and it appears to be a happy ending for them both. However, Taka carries deep, painful trauma related to loving and being loved. A love story between a camboy and his paying subscriber, born through a screen.

182811.description:
Student By Day, Adventurer By Night!

Here I am, reincarnated into the world of Love & Magic Academy, an otome game with RPG elements, and I’m one of the love interests: cool, bespectacled Arius. Wait. Which means…I’m going to get dragged into the romantic scenes just like in the game?! But I have zero interest in romance. And this world isn’t just about romance scenes. It has magic and monsters, and you can raise your stats through dungeon diving. Since I have no interest in romance, I’m going to start off by training and increasing my stats with sword and magic, then I’ll head deep into the dungeons, smashing countless monsters along the way. Here I go, ignoring the romance scenes as I dive into dungeons in order to get stronger!

(Source: Cross Infinite World)

The Brugel Kingdom, known as the land of knowledge, boasts numerous libraries. Within the royal capital lies the Forbidden Library, which houses only cursed books and texts containing abilities that could destroy the nation if misused. Kumura, the Chief Librarian possessing omniscient power, and Vil, the Assistant Librarian wielding the power to bring death to all things, manage, seal, and protect these forbidden texts.

As Kumura and Vil oversee the library, the seal on a forbidden book is suddenly broken, and a giant shrouded in mist appears. To reseal it, Vil confronts the giant, using the power known as the Grim Reaper!!

Just after resealing the book, Vil receives an offer from a hostile empire seeking the Grim Reaper's power.

Vil is attacked in retaliation for refusing the offer, and Kumura is put in danger—! Enraged, Vil unleashes their true power!

The former retainers want to serve the Demon King, even after being reborn as heroes in a new world!

Baldo Barbados, the historically strongest Demon King who brought an end to the long war between humans and demons and ultimately destroyed the world, pities his six Demon Ministers—Silver Wolf, Black Dragon, True Ancestor, Violent Ogre, Evil Spirit, and Dream Demon—who pledged their loyalty to him and died in battle. Baldo, hoping for a peaceful life for his former retainers this time, finds that they have pledged their loyalty again, just as in their past lives, eager to conquer the world, and even acting spoiled!?

182823.description:
Arrogant, charismatic, and untouchable—what more could you possibly ask for from a villain? Zil was the epitome of a final boss, reigning supreme throughout part one of the anime Ragnarök: Twilight of the Gods. However, in a cruel yet hackneyed twist, he was reduced to fodder and insta-killed to make way for the next big baddie's grand entrance.

It's far from the type of fictional character you'd want to randomly wake up as, but that's the sad reality our protagonist finds himself in after falling asleep in front of his TV. Not one to throw in the towel so easily, he swears to defy his fate even if it means facing the gods!

But breaking canon is easier said than done. First, he must build up his strength and his forces while perfectly maintaining Zil's imposing facade and . Uh, hang on. Why is everyone suddenly worshipping him as a god? Oh well, as long as it boosts his chances of survival!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

Surrounded by a loving family, he enjoys a smooth and prosperous life. However, during the selection ceremony to receive magical abilities, he is granted a mysterious innate magic called "Light." While others dismiss it as a "failed" magic, Arte’s past life memories return, revealing the true nature of his magic…!? Using his past life's knowledge, he aims to transform this "failed" magic into the "strongest" magic…!? The strongest and freest adventure of a man known as "Flash" begins now—!

One day, he single-handedly ends a great catastrophe with his sword, becoming a rumored, mysterious hero. His unwitting moniker is…

While everyone searches for the whereabouts of "Ultimate Sword", Aaron is sought out by his brash and strong female disciple and a noble young lady who recognize his incredible abilities, commissioning him to conquer the unexplored depths of a labyrinth. Kanade Hosonami, a high school honor student with the appearance of an angel, has a dark side.

That being… his tenshi-kei VTuber alternate identity, Belle Ariane.

Kanade has a hard time showing his true personality at school, but when he is Belle, he can truly be himself. One day, Belle and his partner Dia, a demon-kei VTuber, decide to collaborate IRL for the first time. The one who shows up at the meeting turns out to be his loner classmate, Amaya, who is rumored to be a delinquent! Kanade is put off at first, but Amaya asks if he would go out with him...?

182836.description:
The adventuring party Sacred is quickly becoming famous for its incredible heroic exploits—and its supremely talented leader, Sasha. Almost no one remembers that Sacred ever had a co-leader: Hyse. Once Sasha's childhood friend, he was booted from the party, reduced from his already tenuous position as workhorse to plain deadweight. Devastation at the betrayal and shame over his own weakness drives Hyse to pour his bitterness into learning his Ability, an unfathomable power not even he fully understands.

Now mistrustful but determined, Hyse steps up to take on the world—and the comrades who abandoned him.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

182837.description:
Rion, a boy who has survived for ten years in the "Demon Realm," a land overrun with monsters, is secretly a former prince, banished for being a cursed child without a crest.

Though he had vowed never to involve himself with the royal family again, Rion learns of an assassination attempt on his younger sister, Princess Celestia, and finally decides to return to the capital.

Concealing his true identity, Rion reunites with his sister, acting as her bodyguard at times, and a mysterious swordsman at others, eliminating the threats against her one after another. When an unprecedented crisis, one that threatens the entire kingdom, befalls the princess, Rion unleashes the true power he has kept hidden—the power of the Heroic King that dwells within him!

A clandestine, unrivaled fantasy of the strongest prince, inheriting the power of legendary kings!

182840.description:
Asada, a lackluster office worker in his second year on the job, spends his days enduring the relentless scoldings of his elite demon boss, Chief Furutaka, who happens to be his neighbor on the floor above. One day, when Asada visits Furutaka’s office to resolve a work-related issue, he’s shocked to discover a chaotic mess! The chief’s appearance is strikingly different, and for the first time, Asada sees Furutaka in a vulnerable light—defenseless and surprisingly kind, treating Asada as if he were a child...!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

182841.description:
In a world where “cakes” are sweet, delectable beings and “forks” prey on them, Amane is a high school student secretly living as a Cake while thriving as a social media influencer. His life takes a surprising turn when Sumeragi, a beloved idol who recently announced his retirement, transfers to his school. Eager to boost his online presence, Amane approaches Sumeragi, but suddenly finds himself pushed down! With a hungry kiss, Sumeragi warns, “If you don’t want to get eaten, stay away from me.” In that moment, Amane realizes the shocking truth: Sumeragi is a fork!

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

One day, Haru, who has a severe allergy to cats, unexpectedly meets Hiiragi, a senior who bears an uncanny resemblance to his favorite feline. Intrigued, Haru asks Hiiragi if he can pet him, but to his disappointment, Hiiragi refuses. Things take an unexpected turn when Haru witnesses Hiiragi making a bold move toward another man...?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

182843.description:
Haruto, a company employee who becomes irresistibly seductive when he drinks, finds himself getting drunk after a late shift and crashing at a bar. Just when things take a wild turn, a striking yakuza named Yuuma appears and is unexpectedly kissed by the alluring Haruto. Captivated by the encounter, Yuuma swiftly takes Haruto to a hotel, where he is overwhelmed by intoxicating pleasure. The next day, Yuuma arrives at the office in a sleek black luxury car, ready to present Haruto with a tantalizing proposal..!?

(Source: CLLENN, translated)

182844.description:
After Tae-Yoon's ex-boyfriend sends a package to his old address, he quickly rushes to get it before anybody sees it. There, he unexpectedly runs into Jae-Min, a former high school classmate with whom he shares a tense and complicated past. Tae-Yoon flees quickly, hoping it will be their final encounter, but fate insists on intertwining their paths again. To confront his lingering guilt, he offers Jae-Min a sincere apology, only to be met with a shocking suggestion—that they meet five more times. What seems like a simple request leaves Tae-Yoon both confused and anxious, as he begins to wonder what Jae-Min’s true intentions might be.

(Source: Lezhin US)

182845.description:
Hong Yoon is on the brink of death after a sudden motorcycle accident when he comes face to face with Lee Tae-Shin, a grim reaper from the underworld. Yoon pleads desperately for his life, but Tae-Shin responds with cold indifference—until he realizes that Yoon is the one person he once helped out of genuine compassion in a past encounter. Bound by that rare act of grace, Tae-Shin reluctantly postpones Yoon’s death. To justify this decision, Tae-Shin appoints Yoon as his temporary assistant. But the role comes with a heavy price: Yoon must regularly transfer yang energy to Tae-Shin through intimate physical contact. Though hesitant, Yoon agrees, knowing it's the only way to survive.

As the line between duty and desire blurs, both man and reaper are forced to confront their past, their bond, and the strange pull growing between them in the space between life and death.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

182847.description:
Seol Ipsae likes to keep things simple and clean: relationships never go further than physical, and one night per guy is the standard, and only the best will do. So when he runs into the big, bumbling himbo Jeong Han-Eum, he can’t believe his eyes; at first, it’s because the dude’s such a nerd, but then it’s because this nerd is hiding a big, uh, “secret.” Huge, in fact. Massive. One of the biggest Ipsae has ever seen. Y’know, maybe nerdy boys aren’t so bad after all…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Chapter count includes six side story chapters.

182849.description:
Once a member of a powerful gang, Gu Tae-Won is now broke, homeless, and on the run. With nowhere left to turn, he finds himself on the edge—literally—contemplating his life atop a bridge. Just when things seem hopeless, a well-dressed stranger approaches with a surprising offer:

“You need some money, right? I can help you.”

Tae-Won doesn’t refuse the offer to spend one night together with this strange man…but can he trust the hand that’s pulling him back from the brink?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes three side story chapters.

The photographer Lin Hao was on assignment at Lintian Old Town when he was killed during an attack by the monster “ET No. 002.” But he found himself reborn as a koi fish, swimming in the Old Town's Dragon Pond. He awakens a powerful Leveling System, which promises him a chance to become a true dragon by following the system's prompts to devour pray and evolve!

He thought that the shame she would carry for the rest of her life would be enough to fulfill his life's purpose as a dragon slayer.
But two years later, when Leon opened his eyes, he found a young dragon girl with a tail sleeping next to him…

Nonoka, newly arrived in the big city for university, goes to her comedian brother’s home where she is to live. But when she gets there, she is greeted by none other than her brother’s comedy partner, the famously shameless playboy Watarase, who is also living there! A lady-killer with no sense of personal space, he’s definitely someone she doesn’t want to get too close to but…! Coincidentally, this shrine is the site of an incident from 10 years ago, when she briefly went missing. Curious about why her classmate is researching the place, her actions trigger an unexpected turn of events. Thus begins a supernatural romantic comedy where their feelings intertwine, sparked by the mystery of the disappearances!

182863.description:
This supporting character is too strong!? An exhilarating, unrivaled fantasy of the strongest Sword Saint with godlike insight begins!

Lastis, one of the seven great Sword Saints of the Almut Kingdom, possesses the godlike skill 'Divine Eye', allowing him to see everything. Once lauded as the strongest, Lastis has since retired to a rural territory due to certain circumstances.

One day, Lastis is summoned to the royal capital for a progress report. There, he encounters Sati, a silver-haired beauty who was expelled from her family for her inability to master her godlike skill and was attacked by thugs. When Lastis saves Sati, she immediately requests to become his disciple, "Please take me as your disciple!"!? Overwhelmed, Lastis agrees to train Sati…and before he knows it, various girls possessing godlike skills begin to gather around him—from a tsundere ice-type rookie Sword Saint to the adorable young ace of the knight order—!?

Meanwhile, rumors of increasing demon activity spread throughout the land. Ordered by the king, Lastis and his companions head to the scene, only to discover it was a diversionary tactic by the demons!?

An exhilarating, unrivaled fantasy begins, where a self-proclaimed supporting character, the strongest Sword Saint, and his disciples shine brilliantly!

"Honestly, what a troublesome bride."
The strongest prince guides a solitary witch to become his bride—a classic academy fantasy beginning with a political marriage!

Will, the apathetic prince—poor at magic and on the verge of failing his classes—is forced into a political marriage by royal decree. His bride is Lilishuka, the "Ice Witch," a famous sorceress from the land of witches, known for her icy beauty—but…

"If you do anything funny, I'll freeze you solid."

She unleashes powerful magic in class, and her dancing and manners are disastrous—far from fitting for a royal bride! With their engagement on the line, Will tries to set an example as a member of the royal family—but then assassins targeting the witch appear…

"Honestly, what a troublesome fiancée."

Faced with his bride's peril, the apathetic prince reveals his true strength—a classic academy fantasy that begins with a political marriage!!

The dungeon life of a sequestered writer?

Hiroki Nishina, a university student, was introduced by his senpai to a part-time job in the light novel editorial department of a publishing company, but on his first day of work, he somehow or other fell into another world(?).

What in the heck is this other world that fills the space below the publishing company? And what will become of university student Hiroki Nishina?

182866.description:
Hayato Kobayashi is haunted by the memory of golden light, a quiet library, and Ritsu Onishi—beautiful, unreadable, always just out of reach. Back then, when Hayato leaned in for stolen kisses, Ritsu simply accepted them without question... or definition. Then high school ended, before either of them could name what they were to each other.

Years later, they meet again at work. Ritsu is still effortlessly captivating, and everything Hayato buried comes rushing back. Only now, he finally knows the word for what he felt back then… but is it already too late?

So Hayato makes a reckless proposal: “Let’s relive our youth—just one more time.”

Gald, a boy working as a servant for an Earl’s family, is expelled one day. With nowhere to go, Gald decides to enroll in a magic academy, something he never did in his previous life.

In his past life—Gald was the strongest sage in history!

In the entrance examination for the world's most prestigious magic academy, Gald, a commoner, surpasses nobles who can only use intermediate-level magic, demonstrating mastery over the highest level of magic, overwhelming them!

After enrolling, Gald continues to use his overwhelming power as a sage, defeating all enemies in the arena and dungeons alike, enjoying his academy life alongside two beautiful girls he met there, Yuri and Sasha.
synonyms: The Servant Who Was Expelled For Being Worse Than Trash Was Actually a Sage In His Past Life: The Strongest Sage Ever Attends The World's Top Academy

title.native: ゴミ以下だと追放された使用人、実は前世賢者です　～史上最強の賢者、世界最高峰の学園に通う～
title.romaji: Gomi Ika da to Tsuihou Sareta Shiyounin, Jitsu wa Zense Kenja desu: Shijou Saikyou no Kenja, Sekai Saikouhou no Gakuen ni Kayou

title.native: 筋肉軍記 信長のトレーナー

182878.description:
A school monster horror depicting the activities of Kagezaki Hyoi, a dark cat who defeats the "demons" that possess humans, and his younger brother Rui. Aimi, a junior high school student who tends to be absent due to asthma, calls out to her childhood friend, Hiroki, when she goes to school, but he is cold. And during cleaning time, transfer student Kagezaki Shimoi approached the White Snake Mound, which is rumored to be ominous, and found a skeletal corpse...!?

(Source: eBookJapan Plus, translated)

title.native: トウ狂女子図鑑 ～普通じゃ足りない私たち～
title.romaji: Tou Kyou Joshi Zukan: Futsuu ja Tarinai Watashitachi

title.native: ゴミ捨て場の決戦〜迷子の研磨くん〜
title.romaji: Gomi Sute Ba no Kessen: Maiko no Kenma-kun

182882.description:
Alberto di Saloum is the second prince of the Kingdom of Saloum. While working in the castle, Alberto gets caught in a tremendous rush of magical power and finds himself transferred in a strange land with his brother, the 7th Prince Lloyd. The paved ground, the towering buildings, the unfamiliar clothing… Alberto is perplexed, but he is determined to protect his beloved brother and return to their world. First he has to find food, clothing, and shelter… Just as he was wondering how to do that, he hears, "Hey, hey, hey, what are you guys doing in this back alley?" A woman named Natsume Arisugawa calls out to them and helps them to find a place to live and even a part-time job, as Alberto begins to live in our modern world with Lloyd!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.romaji: Gendai Teni no Dai Ni Ouji

182883.description:
My Pochi is Cute and the Strongest! A Fun Dungeon Streaming Life with Reliable Companions!

"Hey, want to come home with me?"
"Woof!"

Picking up a single puppy changed everything for Tohru, an ordinary high school student, awakening him as a world-rare tamer.

On his first adventure as an aspiring dungeon explorer, Pochi surprisingly defeats the boss in one blow. Pochi...could he be the strongest?!

Tohru's skills attract the attention of Kudou Asuka, a famous streamer, who scouts him. Their streams go viral, showcasing Pochi's cuteness and strength. Tohru becomes a sensation as Japan's first tamer!

An invincible dungeon streaming life with the strongest pets!
synonyms: I Became a Tamer After Picking Up an Abandoned Dog: A Self-Proclaimed Ordinary High School Boy's Dungeon Rampage With Overpowered Pets

title.native: 捨てイヌ拾ったらテイマーになった件　自称・平凡な男子高校生は、強すぎるペットたちと共にダンジョン無双
title.romaji: Sute Inu Hirottara Tamer ni Natta Ken: Jishou Heibon na Danshi Koukousei wa, Tsuyosugiru Pet-tachi to Tomo ni Dungeon Musou

182885.description:
"Boss... That feels so good...!" The girl that I used to have a crush on is now my secretary...who helps me with my sexual urges! After struggling to find a good job, I became the top of my company after hard work and diligence! Then one day, a dull, unassuming woman shows up for a job interview at my company. I thought to myself, "How in the world did she make it past the application screening stage?" Then, it hits me, she's actually the popular girl I used to know in college, Sonozaki! She used to be a bright and outgoing person but now seems to have a darker side... After seeing the popular Sonozaki fallen on hard times, I realize that I can do whatever I want with her huge tits or her throbbing pussy...

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: It released as 36 episodes and sold in 12 chapters.

title.english: Falling into Ecstasy With the Secretary Who Used to Be a Popular Girl
title.native: トロ沼に、イキ落ちる。～性処理秘書は元１軍女子
title.romaji: Toronuma ni, Iki Ochiru. Seishori Hisho wa Moto 1-gun Joshi

title.native: 妻が死んだので代わりに完璧なロボットを作った話
title.romaji: Tsuma ga Shinda no de Kawari ni Kanpeki na Robot wo Tsukutta Hanashi

182890.description:
“I’m baaaaaaaaaack!!!”

Six years ago, Yura Natsuki was summoned to another world as a hero. Drawn into the war between humans and demons, he was told the typical trope—to return to his world, he had to defeat the Demon King. He fought desperately, siding with the humans who ruthlessly cast aside even their own kind, used as a pawn, and forced into a horrific war—all because he desperately wanted to survive.

He finally managed to return to Earth, only to encounter even more fantastical elements than another world—gods, angels, and aliens!?

"Earth is pretty fantastical, huh?"
synonyms: Earth Turned Out to Be Pretty Fantastical After I Returned From Another World. Also, Stop Staring at Me, You Loser Heroines.

title.native: 異世界から帰還したら地球もかなりファンタジーでした。あと、負けヒロインどもこっち見んな。
title.romaji: Isekai kara Kikan Shitara Chikyuu mo Kanari Fantasy Deshita. Ato, Make Heroine-domo Kocchi Minna.

182891.description:
Prince Theodulf, the third prince, was exiled to the harsh northern lands, a region where food is scarce, at the age of thirteen. This was because he did not receive a 'Gift,' a special power bestowed by a goddess upon individuals at that age.

Only Layla, his beautiful maid, followed him.

Survival seemed impossible, but Theodulf, who is actually a reincarnated individual, had already received a certain 'power' from the goddess during his reincarnation.

This power was called 'Automatic Creation.' It was a cheat skill that allowed him to automatically create anything. Theodulf produced not only weapons, farm tools, and houses, but also golems, weaponry, and other unbelievable things! His village was visited by various races, including humans and beastmen, and it rapidly flourished—

"Wait a minute...isn't this beyond the level of a mere village anymore?"

And so began Theodulf's extraordinary territorial development as the new lord!
synonyms: The Exiled Reincarnated Prince Builds The Strongest Village With His "Automatic Creation" Skill: A Relaxed Territorial Development Slow Life Starting With The Strongest Crafting Skill

title.native: 追放された転生王子、『自動製作』スキルで領地を爆速で開拓し最強の村を作ってしまう　～最強クラフトスキルで始める、楽々領地開拓スローライフ～
title.romaji: Tsuihou Sareta Tensei Ouji, "Jidou Seisaku" Skill de Ryouchi wo Bakusoku de Kaitaku Shi Saikyou no Mura wo Tsukutte Shimau: Saikyou Craft Skill de Hajimeru, Rakuraku Ryouchi Kaitaku Slow Life

title.native: 泥船貴族のご令嬢～幼い弟を息子と偽装し、隣国でしぶとく生き残る！～
title.romaji: Dorosen Kizoku no Goreijou: Osanai Otouto to Musuko to Gisoushi, Ringoku de Shibutoku Ikinokoru!

182894.description: Kagamihira, remembering his past life as a powerful mage in another world, acquired immense magical abilities. However, these powers proved useless in his current reality. Deciding to return to the world of his past life, Kagamihira—now going by the name Tyler—began his adventurer's life. Tyler intended to live a carefree existence, using his powerful magic. One day, however, Elza, the leader of the city's strongest party, "Valkyries," approached him, claiming, "I know your secret…"
synonyms: A 30-Something Mage's Relaxed Harem Life: A Laid-Back Life Traveling Between Worlds

title.native: アラサー魔術師のゆる～いハーレムライフ ～異世界と現代を行き来してのんびり暮らします～
title.romaji: Arasaa Majutsushi no Yurui Harem Life: Isekai to Gendai wo Ikiki Shite Nonbiri Kurashimasu

182895.description:
The Strongest Royal Court Magician In History

Arnold, a member of the "Seven Masters," the court magicians of the Desanto Kingdom, was tasked with defending territories overrun by powerful monsters alongside his subordinates. However, due to a lack of success in expanding the kingdom's territory, he was exiled.

Having no other choice, Arnold, along with his subordinates who had also suffered unfair treatment, fled to the neighboring kingdom of Limble.

After registering as an adventurer in Limble, Arnold sets out to create a large adventurer group, a "clan," aiming to avoid being exploited again.

Suddenly, Arnold encounters Sakura, a knight of the kingdom, in the city. Upon hearing her story, Arnold learns that she is searching for her missing sister, Ouka. Arnold, utilizing his power as a court magician, uses a magical tool to pinpoint Ouka's location based on her belongings and successfully rescues her.

Furthermore, after revealing his identity as one of the "Seven Masters," it turns out that he is incredibly famous in Limble—to the point of being a household name!

The strongest royal court magician begins his rise to power alongside his talented subordinates in this ultimate magical fantasy!
synonyms: The Royal Court Magician's Exile: Dismissed as Incompetent, The Master Magician Forms an Adventurer Clan With His Subordinates

title.native: 宮廷魔導師、追放される　～無能だと追い出された最巧の魔導師は、部下を引き連れて冒険者クランを始めるようです～
title.romaji: Kyuutei Madoushi, Tsuihou Sareru: Munou da to Oidasareta Saikou no Madoushi wa, Buka wo Hikitsurete Boukensha Kuran wo Hajimeru You desu

title.native: 巨乳ファンタジー外伝

182902.description:
Asahi Hinode, a 30-year-old woman living with her parents is single but has no desire to marry. This is because her grandmother, mother, and sisters have all been through multiple divorces, and Hinode has witnessed and heard about marital disputes countless times. One day, when her home washing machine breaks down, Hinode visits a nearby laundromat. While reading a book as she waits for her laundry to finish, a suspicious figure in a spacesuit approaches her. This self-proclaimed angel who claims predicts that Hinode will soon meet three men, and she will end up marrying one of them...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

182904.description:
Obstetrician Im Seo-in’s recurring dreams of an unknown man contrast sharply with her passionless marriage. After a car accident, she awakens in 15th-century Joseon as Lady Park, reliving a life eerily mirroring her own, entangled in betrayal and hidden secrets. Meanwhile, divorce attorney Yoo Han-hoon, inexplicably drawn to her, discovers their fates have intertwined across lifetimes. As past and present collide, Seo-in must break the cycle of tragedy or remain forever bound to a cursed fate.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: 悪縁〜運命の借りを返すとき〜
ดวงร้าย ชะตารัก

title.native: セカンドアニバーサリー

182906.description: Note: Published in COMIC Doki! Special 2010-05

182907.description:
Almaeira Serenelie is a “saint” who was executed by the king because she was falsely accused of being an agent of the Demon Lord. She had a childhood friend, the wizard Yoal Yaotl, who was killed by the mob along with the saint. Twenty years later, he crawls out from the depths of the underworld and reappears in the remote Witch's Forest. Yoal's goal is to reunite with Almaeira, the former saint resurrected by the Demon Lord and forced into his service as the "Witch Queen." Yoal will do anything and pay any cost, in his quest to save the fallen saint from the Demon Lord.

(Source: Kadokawa, transalted)

182908.description:
"I feel I'm very lucky, because I'm with you!"

(Source: Creative Comic Collection, translated)

title.native: 我的幸運，因你而起～星之日常～
title.romaji: Wo De Xingyun, Ying Ni Er Qi: Xing Zhi Richang

182909.description: A biographical manga focusing on the famous sumo brothers Takanohana and Wakanohana.

title.native: 力人伝説 -鬼を継ぐもの-
title.romaji: Chikarabito Densetsu: Oni wo Tsugu Mono

182910.description:
I have a massive crush on my classmate, Takase Narumi. My dream is for her to become friends with my shy, introverted twin sister, Kotomi, too, so that we can all live happy ever after in the same class. However, there's one problem: Takase’s best friend, Momoi Maho, a blonde half-Japanese gyaru and online celebrity, who is a beautiful girl, but also famous for hating boys. She treats me coldly, too, but I was hoping she can at least get along with my sister…

One day, my sister asks me for a favor. She's nervous about meeting her online game waifu in person and she wants me to go in her place. I agreed to help her out, but to my surprise, the person waiting for me at the meetup was none other than Momoi Maho—!?

(Source: Dash Bunko, translated)
synonyms: I Have Zero Otaku Knowledge, But I Somehow Ended Up Enjoying Otaku Activities with A Gyaru Who Hates Men

title.native: オタク知識ゼロの俺が、なぜか男嫌いなギャルとオタ活を楽しむことになったんだが
title.romaji: Otaku Chishiki Zero no Ore ga, Nazeka Otoko Girai na Gyaru to Ota-katsu wo Tanoshimu Koto ni Nattan daga

182911.description:
A reliable office worker, Hanaichi Fudo, undoubtedly had a gift for the arts but gave up on his dreams of becoming an artist to lead a normal life. One day, his senior at work, Saori Wakaba, asked Hanaichi for help in writing her manga. Will he take up the pen again?! Written by Yosuke Matsumoto, author of "The Lady Becomes an Idol", a unique new take on aspiring manga artists!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

Note: Includes 13 extra chapters.

182915.description:
At his college circle's drinking party, Akasaka and Akari-senpai were excitedly talking about their favorite band. In the middle of this drunken mood, he invites her to go to a concert with him, but she tells him she already has a boyfriend, so she turns down the invitation. However, rumors are swirling that her boyfriend is overbearingly restrictive and seems to have a psychologically abusive tendency, among other things...

He goes home after the drinking party ends, and while thinking about Akari-senpai, his doorbell suddenly rings. Upon opening the door, the person standing there in front of him was none other than...?

(Source: FANZA, translated)

Note: Published in Comic Hotmilk 2024-09.
synonyms: How to Heal a Bruised Heart

182916.description:
“What have I done wrong?”

That’s the question Hyo-in An asks herself as she’s ignored and bullied by her former friends at school. She used to get along with everyone, until Juhye Kim and the other kids she thought were her friends began excluding her from their group and treating her horribly. But Hyo-in has an ace up her sleeve that could turn this whole situation around. Her uncle, the developer of the messaging app KitTalk, has given her a special phone that lets her access the group chats where her ex-friends badmouth her behind her back. Her initial hopes of being included again turn into desire for revenge, and Hyo-in begins using the phone to her advantage, making morally questionable choices along the way.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: There is no chat group for me
แชตกลุ่มที่ไม่มีฉัน

182917.description:
Actor Yoo Haek-Yeong has been in love with his spoiled friend Seo Kwon-Yeong for more than 10 years. Not only is it a hopeless love, but it’s downright abuse as Kwon-Yeong takes complete advantage of Haek-Yeong’s feelings to constantly boss him around. Haek-Yeong just can’t help letting Kwon-Yeong string him along… until he connects with his crush’s older brother, Kwon-Lim, the top actor in Korea. Unlike his manipulative brother, Kwon-Lim is thoughtful and kind—and incredibly handsome. As Haek-Yeong grows closer to Kwon-Lim, the dynamic between him and his old friend begins to shift—and so do Haek-Yeong’s long-harbored feelings…

(Source: Tappytoon)

182918.description:
A lawless wasteland known as the Choya Desert was created by a past war. Romeo Rubin, a lone mercenary who's made a name for himself in this harsh land, finds an unexpected new sidekick—a cactus?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

synonyms: An Exiled Blacksmith Uses His Cheat Skills to Forge Legends: His Fiancée Kicked Him Out of His Store, but He’s Happier Now That He Can Make Things at Will

title.native: 追放された鍛冶師はチートスキルで伝説を作りまくる ～婚約者に店を追い出されたけど、気ままにモノ作っていられる今の方が幸せです～
title.romaji: Tsuihou Sareta Tanyashi wa Cheat Skill de Densetsu wo Tsukuri Makuru: Konyakusha ni Mise wo Oidasareta kedo, Kimama ni Mono Tsukutteirareru Ima no Hou ga Shiawase desu

182922.description:
On the advice of a suspicious bard, Albrea—the kingdom's strongest knight—sets off to the remote village of Montt to slay an evil demon. However, when she arrives, Albrea finds out the demon is just a retired old man! And he's far from the only strange inhabitant—there's also a demonic sword taking the form of a young girl, a money-hungry witch, and a drunken priest.

As it turns out, the village has another, lesser-known name—the Maxed-Out Village—and is home to many of the kingdom's greatest heroes! With help from those she came to fight, can Albrea learn what it truly means to be a knight? And what was the bard's real reason for sending her to Montt in the first place?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: The Retired Demon of the Maxed-Out Village
title.native: カンスト村のご隠居デーモンさん
title.romaji: Counter Stop Mura no Goinkyo Demon-san

182923.description:
Misato had a perfect childhood, with parents who loved her and a home on an idyllic island in Japan's inland sea. But then a TV show starts shooting in town. Misato's cast as an extra, and in an instant, her life is turned on its head. A woman appears claiming to be her real mother, and before she knows it Misato is living in a lavish mansion surrounded by greedy schemers of all stripes. The curtain rises on the story of a rising star who plunges into an abyss—where the only sustenance is vengeance!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title.english: Roar: A Star in the Abyss

182924.description:
Police Lieutenant Hyakka Ritsu has always held a deep-seated hatred for Dom Professor Isemi. Once a Normal living a straightforward life, Ritsu’s world was turned upside down by Isemi during their college days, when his hidden submissive tendencies were awakened, leaving him vulnerable to Isemi’s commands. Since then, Ritsu has denied his submissiveness, buried under layers of resentment. Years later, they reunite to collaborate on a criminal investigation. Ritsu struggles to accept Isemi’s reassurances that he will never hurt him again and genuinely wants to make him happy this time. Yet, as they work together, Ritsu finds himself increasingly drawn to Isemi's commands, battling his conflicting emotions...

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 嫌いなあなたに跪く-Dom/Subユニバース-
title.romaji: Kirai na Anata ni Hizamazuku: Dom/Sub Universe

182925.description:
Mashiro Shiki, a member of the idol group Als, is thrilled to be cast in a long-desired TV drama series. The lead role is played by the rapidly rising actor Kirigaya Sui. As filming begins, Shiki senses a barrier between them, feeling that Sui views him merely as an “idol.” Determined to bridge the gap, Shiki openly expresses his feelings about the drama to Sui. As they work together, Shiki discovers unexpected facets of Sui’s personality, leading to a shift in his emotions. What begins as admiration gradually evolves into a deep sense of fandom...

(Source: LEED Publishing, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.
synonyms: The Spin-off Make Me Fall in Love with You

title.native: スピンオフで会いましょう

182926.description:
A super-cheat wizard DK (high school boy) appears!!

One day, a super-famous Arima-kun transfers to the school. He is a man recognized by the whole world as a real wizard. He is good-looking, has a good personality, and is extremely proactive... But will his days of being manipulated by the slightly air-headed Arima-kun begin?!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

182928.description:
20 nights, 20 terrifying stories. Masaya Hokazono tells us the horrific stories he has experienced as well as those that have been told to him.

Even in a technologically advanced modern Japan, traditional spirits never cease to torment the living.

Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

182929.description: A remake of the classic volleyball manga.

182930.description:
From the day he was born until the moment he died, 25-year-old Yusuke Yahagi never had a say in his life. Even after being hit by a truck and sent to a new world, he was given a job he hadn’t asked for: a dagashi-ya. But the cheap and tasty snacks that line his shop are different from those back in Japan. From Curry Rice Crackers to Anzu Sticks, each item comes with its own special effects. Unfortunately, this new world has no idea what dagashi are! It’s up to Yahagi to teach them about the wonders of dagashi as he builds a new life for himself, selling his stat-boosting snacks to help adventurers in need and earning loyal customers—like the lively pink-haired Meryl, the mysterious man in the silver mask, and maybe even a witch or two...?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: Dagashi-ya Yahagi: Setting Up a Sweets Shop in Another World
title.native: 駄菓子屋ヤハギ 異世界に出店します
title.romaji: Dagashiya Yahagi: Isekai ni Shutten Shimasu

182931.description:
From the day he was born until the moment he died, 25-year-old Yusuke Yahagi never had a say in his life. Even after being hit by a truck and sent to a new world, he was given a job he hadn’t asked for: a dagashi-ya. But the cheap and tasty snacks that line his shop are different from those back in Japan. From Curry Rice Crackers to Anzu Sticks, each item comes with its own special effects. 1. Sayonara Oyasumi Mata Ashita 1 (さよならおやすみまたあした 1)
2. Ohayou (おはよう)
3. Tan Tan (たんたん)
4. Noelle-Baasan (ノエルばあさん)

ドクターチルドレン～小児外科医～

182938.description:
Alice hordes newspapers and furniture in her house for her father, who has gone to war with a neighboring country and does not know if he will return. When Carona visits the house, she decides to make her clean up this dump...?

Note: Published in GOOD! Afternoon issue 40/2014.

182939.description: To asses if humans can continue to exist, three angels become human for three days to find out if the humans on earth are worthy

182941.description:
One day, on her way home from work, a strange man called out to her. She turned, irritated that she was being hit on yet again, only to find a glittering princely guy instead.

He said that she looked just like his beloved "Hoi-chan", and couldn't help but call out to her.
Was this his way of trying to ask her out?

No, he's definitely just making fun of her.
She can't stand it when men do this...

She turned and walked away, but when she opened her eyes, she was in a room she didn't recognize and dressed in some hideous clothes.

The man who called out to her walked inside and told her his name. Kesedo.
He also told her that she'd be his pet rabbit from now on.

She didn't understand why, but she knew she couldn't stay.
She had to get away from this man before it was too late...

A manga version of the incredibly popular audio work of the same name!

title.native: 釘師玉出のホール日誌

182944.description: Habu Mioh, the son of the Dragon King, gets banished to the human realm as punishment for his lack of interest in living up to his role as successor to the throne. Once there, he finds himself under constant attack by various demon beasts, who mostly are interested in getting their hands on his liver, which is said to hold the secrets to eternal life and youthfulness.

182946.description:
1. Shinkon wa Amakunai (新婚は甘くない)

2. Ranjeri Dai Sakusen (ランジェリー大作戦)

3. Waratte Yurushite (笑って許して) Caught in an accident after having had a fight, highschool boxing star Taku and his studious classmate Kaori awake in the other's body.

182947.description:
After spending over a century hiding in the shadows, powerful sorceress Sadako stumbles upon the dazzling world of social media and decides to post her way into her first real contact with humanity. She soon becomes an internet sensation, attracting a huge following of doting fans—and shocks them all by announcing she is a witch. The big reveal turns one follower called Hanako, a lonely young woman with seemingly inhuman strength and a curious resistance to magic, into a dedicated hater, and inadvertently sends them both on a whirlwind adventure beyond their wildest dreams!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

182950.description:
When Vidrak the Death God invades and the fate of humanity hangs in the balance, the greatest mages of the realm stand in defiance… only to find that their spells have no effect, as the dark overlord effortlessly picks apart their attacks. Overwhelmed by a horde of monsters, long-range mage Setsuna Cromwell uses his last resort, the Amulet of Resurgence, to travel 10 years into the past. Now a freshman twice over, Setsuna must go against the grain by studying melee magic, known as the least prestigious domain – and the only one with a chance of defeating Vidrak.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: A Regressão de um Mago Combatente

title.english: Regression of the Close Combat Mage
title.native: 2周目の大魔導士は近接魔法で無双する
title.romaji: 2-Shuume no Daimadoushi wa Kinsetsu Mahou de Musou Suru

182951.description:
Rudy has a goal—to become a top-tier weaponsmith and make the coolest weapons the world has ever seen! Sure, her boss always gets mad about her bizarre creations, but she has a blast crafting them. And she lives right outside a dungeon, so she's in the perfect spot to aid adventurers passing through on their way to fight monsters. Surely she won't bite off more than she can chew…right?

(Source: Yen Press)

title.english: Every Adventure Needs a Weapon! —The Blacksmith Life of Rudy the Obsessed—
title.native: 冒険には、武器が必要だ!～こだわりルディの鍛冶屋ぐらし～
title.romaji: Bouken ni wa, Buki ga Hitsuyou da!: Kodawari Rudy no Kajiyagurashi

182952.description:
"Cuteness is indomitable!"

Day after day, the mysterious Mira rampages around, trying to steal the hero's transformation belt. Mira is at full power, having been remodeled by the doctor, but it turns out her new form is that of an incredibly cute girl! Mira, who has been remodeled based on the theories that "a hero won't raise a hand against women and children" and "justice cannot defeat cuteness," has been ordered to make the hero fall in love and to steal his belt.

Meanwhile, the hero, who thinks love is a source of trouble, is at the mercy of Mira's cuteness, but he swears he will never fall in love with her. So begins a romantic comedy where justice and evil refuse to yield to each other!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

title.native: 怪人ミラの第2形態が可愛すぎる
title.romaji: Kaijin Mira no Dai 2 Keitai ga Kawaisugiru

synonyms: The Headcase and the Vampire Child

title.native: メンヘラと吸血鬼の子供

182955.description:
One night, while working in the wee hours on his newest assignment, Jo Mingyu begins to hear odd sounds coming from another classroom. Following the mysterious moans, he walks into a classroom - only to see a fellow student pleasuring themselves! But lucky for Mingyu, the student just so happens to be his ideal type…and could perhaps provide some inspiration and amusement at the same time!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

182956.description:
A world where humans and beastmen coexist. In the past, beastmen were treated as slaves by humans, and even today, prejudice against them persists due to their appearance. Tired from his work, a beastman doctor named Oushirou meets a kind shopkeeper, Yuki, while trying to buy some side dishes at a supermarket. Yuki, who lost his voice due to his parents' abuse, serves Oushirou with a bright smile. He encourages Oushirou, who has faced discrimination as a beastman, and Oushirou falls in love with Yuki at first sight. Oushirou is so smitten that he even dreams of Yuki. Later, he discovers that only he can hear Yuki's voice, which brings them closer together. Will Oushirou's feelings be conveyed to Yuki?

(Source: Junet, translated)

182957.description:
Taiyo Kiriyama knew he wasn’t allowed to have pets in his apartment. But when he comes across an abandoned cat, he can’t help but try to smuggle the sweet creature in! Unfortunately, he’s immediately caught by the building manager, Asahi Taira. After Taiyo begs, Asahi agrees to let him keep the cat for a month while he finds it a home—but in exchange, Taiyo will have to become Asahi’s errand boy.

It’s not an easy gig, but after getting to know Asahi, Taiyo finds that the other man has a hidden charm and begins to enjoy the time they spend together. While Taiyo’s feelings for Asahi begin to grow, he soon learns that Asahi is in love with someone already. Can he help Asahi find his happiness and love, or will Taiyo’s own emotions get in the way?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Includes two chapters of “Higashi Mado no Omukai-san (東窓のお向かいさん)" and one extra chapter.

title.native: 太陽はひだまりと笑う

182958.description:
College student Ayumu Kurosawa moved out of his parents' house to enjoy anal masturbation without any worries. However, his neighbor turns out to be his childhood friend and first love, Junpei Shiraishi. One night, Junpei unexpectedly sees Ayumu playing by himself using a toy. He casually remarks, “Isn’t this one better?” while pulling out his large d**k...! Ayumu feels annoyed at Junpei’s carelessness, but his body tingles at the thought of having such a big "real thing" inside him...!

(Source: CLLENN, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.romaji: Kono Otoko, Kusare En ni Tsuki

182959.description:
A hopeless high school girl gets lost in the mountains and stumbles upon a house and meets an old woman with a big face. It looks sketchy as hell, and sure enough, it is! A horror comedy in 53 pages!

(Source: MANGA Plus)
