Chiisa na Joslyn (小さなジョスリン)

182962.description:
"Standing on the sparkling stage right now is my favorite best friend."

Ryunosuke's favorite member of the five-member idol unit 5-ROUND is his best friend, Rion.

Rion always tells me to “make me your oshi,” but since he’s my best friend and someone I share a room with, it feels complicated. Once I got to know Rion's true self—the side he never shows to his fans—I found myself unable to see him as just an idol anymore.

Ryunosuke supports Rion at his own pace while hiding his true feelings. However, Rion’s thought-provoking behavior often leads Ryunosuke to misunderstandings...?

(Source: EastPress, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: ガチ恋だから推せねーよ！

182963.description:
Game planner Hidaka has always wanted to take down his colleague and rival, Ouno. When he discovers that Ouno is actually gay and tends to lose focus on work when he has a lover, Hidaka sees an opportunity. “This is my chance!” he thinks and decides to disguise himself as “Shiki,” a college student, to approach Ouno and become his “ideal lover.” Hidaka manages to deceive Ouno, but as an inexperienced romantic, he quickly finds himself outmatched. On the very day they meet, he is overwhelmed by Ouno’s advances, leaving him weakened and unsure of how to proceed...!

(Source: Core Magazine, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

182964.description:
"Would you like to try that 'kiss to find out' thing with me?"

Shou and Hiroto are well-known best friends at their all-boys school. They've been joking around and hanging out together since middle school, but recently, Shou has noticed that Hiroto's more mature behavior is making him nervous. Is this love? Or is it just friendship? To find out, Shou decides to try kissing Hiroto once a day. Unlike Shou, who can’t help but feel embarrassed, Hiroto seems to be enjoying this unexpected situation...!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

182965.description:
“Oh, I'm being raped by a monster...”

One day, Akira, who works for a toy company, misses the last train home. Forced to get off at a strange, old station, he thinks he’s alone until a boy approaches him and warns, “It’s dangerous here...” Suddenly, Akira hears a voice that sounds almost human. Turning around, he comes face-to-face with a monster—a tentacle extending towards him, groping his body and finally reaching the lower half. Is this a dream? Reality?

(Story: MUGENUP, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: お祓いするから挿れますね

182966.description: Once upon a time, there was a village. The village needed a young woman to be sacrificed to Inugami-sama in order to protect it. With a shortage of women, a young man named Kahuna was chosen.

title.native: 生贄は生還できません!

182967.description:
Himeno Yui, the oddball of the class, finds his “shounen manga artist who's on the edge of the cliff” side exposed by the class prince, Ouji Hinata! Meanwhile, Ouji harbors a secret of his own: he is a devoted “shoujo manga lover.” Tensions rise as Himeno teases him about romantic relationships. However, when the editor who works with Hinata suggests that he try writing shoujo manga, he decides to take the plunge and shouts to Ouji, “Teach me shoujo manga!”

From that day on, the two opposites embark on a secret journey of “heart flutter lessons,” exploring their different worlds and the budding connection between them!

(Source: Shodensha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 姫野くんはときめきたい

182968.description:
“Yama… I’m coming. Just wait for me.”

Young actor Umi Fukai is known for his looks—but rarely recognized for his talent. For years, he’s survived the harsh entertainment industry by holding onto one precious memory: Yama, the mysterious young man who praised his performance in a fifth-grade school play. But just as the constant judgment and disappointment begin to break his spirit, he finally discovers the whereabouts of the one person he’s longed to see again…

(Source: comici MANGA)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

182969.description:
A gay and slutty college student, Shouta, finds his relative Shirou coming to stay at his house. Shouta isn’t thrilled about it and tries various ways to get rid of him, but Shirou proves to be quite resilient and pushes back.

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

182970.description:
I don’t know how it happened, but somehow I’ve died and reincarnated into my favorite academy game. And if that wasn’t weird enough, I’m now the depraved and lazy villain, Weiss Fansent, whose misdeeds lead him to a deadly end. Something I’m determined to avoid at all costs. With little time left until the academy’s entrance exams, I have no choice but to dive headfirst into serious and grueling training. Which means swordsmanship with the S-rank adventurer Miruku Abitas, followed by intense magic practice. It was demanding and exhausting, but getting stronger means I have a better chance of avoiding my disastrous end.

But I seriously underestimated just how powerful Weiss truly is, and I wind up stunning everyone at the exams! Have I somehow become more powerful than the hero?

A fantasy series about changing the villain’s fate with hard work and amazing powers!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: Reincarnated as the Lazy and Villainous Noble, I Broke the Scenario and Became the Most Formidable With Extraordinary Magic

title.english: Reborn as an Aristocratic Scoundrel, I Broke the Game and Mastered Magic Beyond Limits!
title.native: 怠惰な悪辱貴族に転生した俺、シナリオをぶっ壊したら規格外の魔力で最凶になった
title.romaji: Taida na Akujoku Kizoku ni Tensei Shita Ore, Scenario wo Bukkowa Shitara Kikaku-gai no Maryoku de Saikyou ni Natta

182971.description:
Luca is a girl who gained the ability to create duplicates of herself when expressing strong desires, as a consequence of a certain incident. She has been living by her father's teachings, who disappeared leaving only a note saying "Abandon all desires." However...

(Source: MANGA Plus, edited)

182973.description:
Huang Tianfang, who reincarnated as the “World’s Greatest Villain” in the Chinese-style fantasy game 'Chronicles of The Legendary Sword Master', must find a way to survive. His first task to avoid the ruinous ending is to save his stepsister, Seirei, who is destined to become a seductive villlainess capable of toppling nations—!?

But will Huang Tianfang’s actions, which differ from the game’s plot, start having unexpected effects on those around him...?
synonyms: The Boy Who Reincarnated as the World's Greatest Villain Becomes a Charismatic Hero: I’ll Build a Heroic Army with Beautiful Girls Who Can Topple Nations

title.native: 天下の大悪人に転生した少年、人たらしの大英雄になる　～傾国の美少女たちと英雄軍団を作ります～
title.romaji: Tenka no Daiakunin ni Tensei Shita Shounen, Hitatarashi no Daieiyuu ni Naru: Keikoku no Bishoujo-tachi to Eiyuugundan wo Tsukurimasu

182974.description:
Walker, a man reincarnated as an adventurer, is suddenly attacked in a dungeon by a high-level monster and realizes he's in the dark fantasy world of a manga he read in his previous life. Not only that, but he also isn't the protagonist—he's an ill-fated side character meant to die alongside his party to establish the setting's grim tone! Walker fights tooth and nail for his friends, and although he loses a leg and an eye in the process, he manages to prevent everyone's terrible fates. But as he adjusts to a new life with an injured body, his female comrades begin to act strangely toward him!

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: I Desperately Avoided the Total Annihilation Ending. The Party Fell Into Distress.

title.english: Our Party Nearly Wiped and Then Everything Went Downhill
title.native: 全滅エンドを死に物狂いで回避した。パーティが病んだ。
title.romaji: Zenmetsu End wo Shini Mono Kurui de Kaihi Shita. Party ga Yanda.

182975.description:
I, Kusumi Yuto, an ordinary high school student, accidentally let my beloved parakeet, Pee-chan, escape outside one day. While chasing after Pee-chan, I encountered the school's unattainable beauty, Tachibana Rino.

After thanking her for taking care of Pee-chan, just as I'm about to leave—

“Senpai wants to date, but someone like me is probably impossible.”
“Yesterday, Kusumi looked really cool!”

Pee-chan exposes the feelings of both me and Senpai! (But it’s fine since we ended up becoming a couple.) However, Pee-chan keeps showing up at school, during our dates, and even at our travel destinations...?

This is a sweet and teasing romantic comedy tied together by a modern-day love cupid (parakeet)!
synonyms: The Chatty Parakeet Confessed to the Beautiful Student Council President I Admire, but the Parakeet Also Revealed the President's Feelings

title.native: 憧れの美人生徒会長にお喋りインコが勝手に告白したけど、会長の気持ちもインコが暴露しやがった
title.romaji: Akogare no Bijin Seitokaichou ni Oshaberi Inko ga Katte ni Kokuhaku Shita Kedo, Kaichou no Kimochi mo Inko ga Bakuro Shiyagatta

182976.description:
Ginga and Ruka, are childhood friends.
Ginga had always loved Ruka, who was strong and dazzling, and who had always protected him when he was a crybaby. As childhood friends and best friends, he was satisfied with always being close to him.
Even when a friend urged him, “Someone else will snatch him away,” Ginga couldn't bring himself to take that first step. He didn't want someone else to take him, but he also lacked the courage to express his feelings... One day, while drunk, his suppressed feelings are revealed...?

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 離れられない、逃がしてやれない

synonyms: Let Me Buy Your Skill Not to Need

title.native: いらないスキル買い取ります

182979.description:
Naoki, who manages an apartment on behalf of his grandfather, is told that his cousin Keigo will be moving in when he starts university. Naoki looks forward to being reunited with Keigo, who had always been fond of him, but he finds that Keigo has grown into a handsome man who is quiet and whose thoughts are hard to read. Although Naoki is confused at first, he begins to feel comfortable with the closer relationship they have as they live near each other... But one day, he finds out that Keigo has been stalking him—?! Naoki just can't bring himself to push Keigo away, and he tries to "correct" his feelings for him somehow...

"If Naoki-nii hates me, how can I live from now on...?"

A pure love (?!) story between a handsome stalker with an intense love and a kind-hearted older man!

(Source: Shueisha, machine translated)

Note: The chapter count includes one extra.

title.native: しょうがないけど愛おしい

182981.description:
The secret evil organization Gokuark has been annihilated by the heroes. Its grand leader and her subordinate Saitou barely made their escape and have begun living in a rundown one-room apartment, but... Can this useless shut-in (but cute) grand leader revive the organization!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: ポンコツ大首領ちゃんとオッサン戦闘員さん。

synonyms: Do-M na Anoko wa Boku no Dorei

title.romaji: Do-M na Ano Musume wa Boku no Dorei

182987.description:
Kou Kimahara is an ordinary high school boy who shares a class with Sakurazaki Nako, a popular JK idol. Even though they don't know each other at all, Nako suddenly approaches Kou one day, asking him, "Hey, you've got free time, right? Want to go to the arcade after school?"

Nako, unfamiliar with typical after-school activities, wants Kou to show her how to enjoy her free time after school, having seen him freely do so every day.

Through arcades, restaurants, and other shared moments, their time together becomes something precious…

"Can I call you tonight?"
"Pat my head like I'm a good girl."
"I want to always feel Himahara-kun with me."

A heart-pounding romantic comedy unfolds, as an immensely popular idol and a high school boy share their daily life!
synonyms: It Seems Like The Active JK Idol Is Interested In Me, A Guy With Too Much Free Time.

title.romaji: Geneki JK Idol-san wa Himajin no Ore ni Kyoumi ga Aru Rashii.

182990.description:
"If I don't forgive you… Who else can?"

Shen Feng, the youngest of the Shen family, once vowed to surpass his childhood mentor and first love, the powerful and graceful Xiao Xing. But when a deadly feud erupts between their families, their bond is torn apart by betrayal and bloodshed. Ordered to destroy the Xiao family, Shen Feng defies fate and spares Xiao Xing—knowing it means losing him forever.

Fifty years later, after his father's assassination, Shen Feng returns home… only to come face to face with the man he thought he'd lost for good. As past and present collide, can love survive the shadows of loss and regret…?

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

1. Hosome Ottori Kyonyuu Mama. (細目おっとり巨乳ママ。)
2. Zoku Hosome Ottori Kyonyuu Mama. (続・細めおっとり巨乳ママ。)
3. Saimin Musume to Tennen Mama (催眠娘と天然ママ, The Gullible Pair)
4. Doutei Choudai!!: Yariman Osanajimi no Sex Friend ni Sareta Hanashi (童貞ちょーだい!!-ヤリマン幼馴染のセフレにされた話-, Gimme Your Virginity!! ~ How I Became My Childhood Friend's Fuck Buddy~)

182992.description:
A dream-come-true scenario quickly becomes a nightmare when a yuri fanboy discovers that he’s been reincarnated into one of his favorite yuri games—as Hiiro, an annoying male character whose only purpose is to get between the heroines. Realizing that he’s destined for ruin in a world where men are at the bottom of the pecking order, Hiiro scrambles to get stronger and avert his fate. But his desperate efforts end up making the game’s heroines—Princess Lapis, Snow the maid, and the protagonist Sakura—fall for him instead of one another! At this rate, he’ll be killed for coming between them! Can Hiiro get the girls interested in one another before it’s too late?

(Source: Yen Press)
182992.hashtag: #ゆりはさ #ゆりはさ感想 #ゆりはさアイコン
synonyms: The Only Thing I Can Do In a Game World Where Men Are Forbidden: I Got Reincarnated as The Guy Stuck Between Yuri
남자 금지 게임 세계에서 내가 해야 할 유일한 일 ~백합 사이에 낀 남자로 전생해버렸습니다~

title.english: The Only Thing I'd Do in a No-Boys-Allowed Game World
title.native: 男子禁制ゲーム世界で俺がやるべき唯一のこと 百合の間に挟まる男として転生してしまいました
title.romaji: Danshi Kinsei Game Sekai de Ore ga Yaru Beki Yuiitsu no Koto: Yuri no Aida ni Hasamaru Otoko Toshite Tensei Shite Shimaimashita

182993.description:
Neon Light, a modern-day Japanese RPG, is a game I dedicated my life to, playing through it multiple times, Now, I stand—no, I've been reincarnated—in the very world of my dreams.

My reincarnated character is Lux, a tired-looking salaryman type I've never even seen mentioned in the game's dialogue. He's an overpowered character so strong it makes me worry about breaking the game's balance.

Despite trying to live quietly so as not to disrupt the game's storyline, I've ended up saving characters destined to die and earning the respect of the final boss even more than the main protagonist—how did this happen!?

An unknowingly overpowered character in an off-script adventure! A new kind of otherworld fantasy!
synonyms: I Reincarnated as an OP Character Who Was Completely Irrelevant to The Story

title.native: 物語に一切関係ないタイプの強キャラに転生しました
title.romaji: Monogatari ni Issai Kankeinai Type no Kyoukyara ni Tensei Shimashita

title.native: ことぶきっ!効福の温泉旅行
僕の恋路を淫乱小（？）悪魔たちが邪魔してくる！

title.native: 助っ人発情！！ムチムチ！助っ人成長！
title.romaji: Suketto Hatsujou!! Muchi Muchi! Suketto Seichou

title.native: コンプラ違反です!檜山さん!
